ruth daley.name: Ruth Daley
ruth daley.origin: Private Detective Mark Mason takes on Ruth Daley as a client after the murder of her father, wealthy Reginald Daley was murdered. She explains that her fiancée Dick Wayne is the prime suspect as her father refused to allow him to marry Ruth. When a gun shot was heard in the house following another argument, Ruth's mother found Dick cradling Reginald's death body. Although the evidence is against Dick, Ruth believes he is innocent and hires Mark to solve the murder. Overhearing this, Mark's secretary Louise Grant decides to pay a visit to the Daley residence as the Blonde Phantom to search for clues. Sneaking into the house she begins look around, when someone tries to attack her from behind, the Blonde Phantom flips the attacker over her shoulder and is surprised to find that it is Dick Wayne. Dick explains that he was hiding out to avoid capture. Blonde Phantom is convinced that Dick is not responsible and convinces him to turn himself over to the police. Searching the office for clues the Blonde Phantom finds documents that reveal that Mrs. Daley was selling the family jewels in order to pay off her gambling debts. Searching the widows room she finds a pile of money and a number of IOU's to various gamblers. Believing this is enough to at least keep Dick away the electric chair, Blonde Phantom calls the police and sets up a trap for Mrs. Daley. Inviting Mrs. Daley to Mark Mason's office, Blonde Phantom confronts her with the truth. When Mrs. Daley attempts to shoot the Blonde Phantom, the masked heroine manages to knock her out with a slap to the face before she can shoot and turns her over to the authorities. Later, Ruth visits Mark office asking him to thank the Blonde Phantom for her help, unaware that Louise is the Blonde Phantom.

ruth durie.name: Ruth Durie
ruth durie.origin: Ruth was a beautiful mutant girl who, with Ell, was captured by the mutant Poppa to be sold for genetic experiments to the highest bidder. They were saved by Magneto, who killed Poppa and then sent Ell and Ruth to the Xavier Institute. It is unknown if she was still in the Institute during the Decimation, but she wasn't seen among the few students who retained their powers, so presumably she was depowered and killed by William Stryker and the Purifiers.

ruth eisenhardt.name: Ruth Eisenhardt
ruth eisenhardt.origin: Ruth Eisenhardt was the sister of Max Eisenhardt, later known as Magneto. In a time when the situation worsened for Jews in Nazi Germany and Ruth's uncle, Erich, suggested to leave the country, her father Jakob insisted that they stay and learn to figure out the rules. They did not stay long after November 7, 1938, when assassinated the German attaché, , and the Nazis started to terrorize Jewish people in the , they fled to Warsaw, Poland. ruth holden.name: Ruth Holden
ruth holden.origin: Hurricane agrees to accompany the Holden expedition into the Mato Grosso, where they will join a Doctor Clay, who is battling a strange body wasting disease that is killing thousands there daily. Hurricane soon learns that the green plague was created by his old nemesis Pluto who has convinced the Jivaro Headhunters to help destabilize the region and prevent all attempts to contain the plague. While Ruth Holden and Ralph Rand work on a cure, Hurricane goes looking for Dr. Clay but learns that he was captured by the Jivaro. Tracking them down he not only finds that the Jivaro had killed Clay, but also captured Holden and Rand. Using his powers to blast through the Jivaro strong hold, Hurricane creates a pair of wings to fly Holden and Rand to safety while he brings the Jivaro's fortress down around them. With the castle destroyed and a cure made for the green plague, Hurricane flies off into the air.

ruth larue.name: Ruth LaRue
ruth larue.origin: During the WWII, Namor was asked to act as security for General David Johnson and actress and former Olympic swimmer Ruth LaRue as they flew from Hawaii to Australia. Attacked by Japanese forces seeking to get Johnson's plans for the "Battle of the Pacific", they were forced to crash land on the island of Maku. There, Namor convinced the locals he was a water-god and had them assist in fighting off the Japanese and escaping to safety.

ruth mastorakis.name: Ruth Mastorakis
ruth mastorakis.origin: Ruth Mastorakis was a young woman who was engaged to a man named Nikos. However, he proclaimed he couldn't marry her, and beat her and humiliated her. Ruth then volunteered to undergo the Morituri process, gaining the ability to produce poisons and their antidotes. She joined the Strikeforce Morituri using the codename Toxyn. Along with Scaredycat and Scatterbrain, she was one of the team's second wave of recruits. Some of the other members tried to make Toxin assume a leadership role, as their previous leader had died, but Toxyn resisted this. Nevertheless, she became a valued member of the team. Seeing her achievements in the media, Ruth's ex-fiance Nikos tried to contact her, much to her anger. When the team faced accusations from the superiors for going against orders, Toxyn used her powers to poison her teammates, only giving them the antidote when she had proved her point. The team were not charged in the end. Toxyn later fell in love with a soldier she had rescued from a Horde ship, but before they could act upon their love, she succumbed to the Morituri effect and her body exploded.

ruth messinger.name: Ruth Messinger
ruth messinger.origin: Congressman Messinger was the chairwoman overseeing the United States Congress Committee when Colonel Talbot was brought before the committee regarding the operations at Gamma Base. The Committee wass unimpressed with the amount of tax dollars that were spent at the facility given the fact that they have failed to carry out its mandate: capture and cure the Hulk. Talbot tried to justify the work that was being done, but the committee pointed out that the only successful thing to come out of Gamma Base was the creation of Doc Samson, which was done by accident. Talbot is thanked for his testimony and the session as adjourned for the day. Eventually, Congress makes their decision to cut funding to Gamma Base and shut the facility down.

ruth piraud.name: Ruth Piraud
ruth piraud.origin: Along the French-Swiss border in the small town of Blanc, Free French resistance fighter Frank Piraud and his men attempt to free their town from the Nazis and the martial law imposed by their commander Colonel von Bitters. In order to try and stop Piraud's attacks on his men, von Bitters has his sister Ruth brought to him and forces her to write a letter to her brother to be delivered to his camp in the hills and then forces her to prepare a feast for his men. Von Bitters sends one of his men to deliver the message under the flag of truce, however the soldier is jumped by the Destroyer who steals his uniform and takes the note up to Piraud's camp. Arriving at the resistance camp, the Destroyer reveals himself to them and delivers the letter. It is a distress from Ruth that the Nazis intend to wipe out their town and kill her if he does not surrender himself immediately. However, the Destroyer does not allow Frank to surrender himself as he has a plan as to how to defeat the Nazis as he overheard the Colonel mention that he was throwing a party that night. Sneaking their way to Ruth's home, they knock on the back door and present themselves to Frank's sister. Then, the Destroyer, Frank and some of the resistance fighters pose as waiters for the party and deliver meals to Von Bitters and his men. They then take the Nazi soldiers by surprise by throwing the entrees at the Nazis and then gunning them down. Learning that Von Bitters is upstairs with Ruth, they rush up there. The Destroyer enters first, attacking Von Bitters, but allows Frank to knock the Nazi commander out. The Destroyer then disguises himself as Colonel von Bitters and after rigging the resistance base with explosives orders the the Colonel's troops to attack it. While the Nazis are raiding the abandoned base, Frank sets off the explosives killing them all and allowing the resistance fighters to take back the village of Blanc.

ruthar.name: Ruthar
ruthar.origin: Ruthar was an Atlantean pirate who teamed up with the mutated criminal called Zoga. The duo formed a band of pirates who robbed military ship and stole their weapons. They formed an alliance with human, deliberately led ships to them to pillage. Zoga and Ruthar made their base operations within a section of the Dead Zone free of toxic gases and chemicals, so not to harm his pirating allies. One of robberies was seen by Namor, who followed the group back to their base. Zoga used his mutated sharks to attack the Sub-Mariner, but he managed to wound one, causing the others to attack it in a feeding frenzy. Namor easily defeated Ruthar, and hunted for Zoga. After a brief fight the Sub-Mariner, who was weakened by poisons of the Dead Zone, impaled Zoga with his own spikes, and his bleeding attracted a his mutated sharks and they attacked. Namor left pirates for dead, and then blew up his secret base.

rutherford princeton iii.name: Rutherford Princeton III
rutherford princeton iii.origin: Rutherford Princeton served as a Canadian police officer during the 1920s. He had been sent "on loan" to Chicago to assist with the enforcement of Prohibition. During this time, Princeton had a romantic relationship with a woman named Amelia, who was later to be revealed as being "Nemesis". The two later served together as members of Alpha Flight, though Princeton was not aware that she was the same woman. For an unknown reason in recent times, Rutherford Princeton was in a coma for just under fifteen years. While researching veterans of the Canadian military, Walter Langkowski became aware of Princeton's unique bio-rhythmic signature. At the age of 96, Rutherford was shocked out of his coma through Langkowski's transformation into "Sasquatch". Langkowski was forming a strike force of Canadian super powered beings to save his teammates, who had been captured by an alien race, The Plodex. Revived from his coma, the elderly Princeton had no desire to join Langkowski's strike force, but rather wanted to live life to its fullest. When he discovered however that with his newfound powers, living a normal life made him feel empty, he agreed to join Langkowski's new Alpha Flight. This mission was successful, and the original members of Alpha Flight decided to transport the Plodex eggs that had been discovered back to the Plodex homeworld. Princeton stayed on as a member of Langkowski's Alpha Flight as Centennial. After a series of blunders attempting to alter the past, a temporally displaced copy of the original Alpha Flight members was brought into the present. It is unknown what transpired after that, however a vague glimpse into the future showed Princeton and his lost love, Amelia, side-by-side in death.

When he discovered however that with his newfound powers, living a normal life made him feel empty, he agreed to join Langkowski's new Alpha Flight. This mission was successful, and the original members of Alpha Flight decided to transport the Plodex eggs that had been discovered back to the Plodex homeworld. Princeton stayed on as a member of Langkowski's Alpha Flight as Centennial. After a series of blunders attempting to alter the past, a temporally displaced copy of the original Alpha Flight members was brought into the present. It is unknown what transpired after that, however a vague glimpse into the future showed Princeton and his lost love, Amelia, side-by-side in death.
abilities: Fighting Skills: Due to his experience and age, Centennial is an experienced fighter. Learned Intellect: Is a learned and experienced individual that has had almost a century of experience and knowledge.

rutherford winner.name: Rutherford Winner
rutherford winner.first_appearance: Daughters of the Dragon - Marvel Digital Original Vol 1 2
rutherford winner.origin: Rutherford Winner was one of the random people kidnapped by the evil organization Hydra as part of their Pygmalion Project, consisting of subjecting regular people to torture, implanted memories, and other procedures in order to rebuild them in their image. After going through the reprogramming, Winner was deployed to the field and proved to be extremely effective on countless missions. However, S.H.I.E.L.D. got hold of him and used him for their own interests. He kept being an impressive killing machine, until finally getting free and going freelance. During that time, he crossed paths with Colleen Wing and Misty Knight, the Daughters of the Dragon, and put them through some tough times. In the end, they decided to help him. Winner was institutionalized at the Ravencroft Institute, and his psychiatrist was Dr. Andrea Sterman. Following Sterman's disappearance, Winner broke out of Ravencroft to rescue her. He confronted his suspect, one of Sterman's other patients, Moon Knight, who was unaware that the Sterman who had conducted his recent sessions was in reality the impersonator Waxman. Winner's confrontation made Moon Knight realize that something was amiss. He exposed Waxman and set out to rescue Sterman alongside Winner.

ry n.name: Ry-N
ry n.origin: Ry-N and his partner Air-Icka were two Sparkitects working on subtly influencing the course of the life of the earthling hero Squirrel Girl. Chipp and Jho stumbled across them on their way to boarding their ship to fly to the Earth. Chipp explained to Ry-N their predicament and its severity, believing that even if he told their superiors, nobody would belive "the nerds workin' on Squirrel Girl." Ry-N later came across Jho, when he had returned to Sparkitron to fix his mistakes. With Jho's control terminal being dismantled by their supervisor Whil, Ry-N lent him his portable version while they both used Ry-N's hoverboard to escape the guards.

ryan griffen.name: Ryan Griffen
ryan griffen.origin: Ryan Griffen was a Secret Service agent. When his daughter Amber was a child, he was tasked with protecting Senator Greg Johnson at an event for his campaign for president. The event was ambushed when X-23 was sent to assassinate the senator on her first trial mission. After killing the senator and his family, X-23 also massacred Ryan and everyone else who attempted to apprehend her. Later that day, young Amber was pulled out of class and informed of her father's death.

ryan trent.name: Ryan Trent
ryan trent.origin: Since he was a kid Ryan Trent was constantly undermined, having his decisions throughout his life continuously questioned. Even after he joined the NYPD, he didn't feel he was good enough. thumb|left|Detective Trent When Moon Knight returned to New York City as a consultant for Detective Flint, Flint's preference over the vigilante caused Trent to finally break, and slowly descend into madness as he became obsessed with Moon Knight. Ryan began training himself, as well as he investigated about Moon Knight by interrogating former allies of him disguised as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Using Carson Knowles, the Black Spectre, as an inspiration, Ryan aimed to replace Moon Knight, believing that if he replaced Moon Knight and revealed himself to Flint, he would get be respected and get a promotion. In order to become even more similar to Moon Knight, who worked alone and had no ties to anybody, Trent murdered his wife. Now armed with equipment and a costume, Trent donned the mantle of Black Spectre and began attacking people and peeling their faces while yelling for Moon Knight. thumb|left|Preparing himself With Moon Knight's car finally arriving at his location, Black Spectre activated three I.E.D. planted in cars nearby to explode Moon Knight's car. Only two of them went off, but this was enough to destroy the vehicle. Black Spectre got out of the building he was hiding, expecting to find Moon Knight's corpse among the ruins. However, Moon Knight arrived at the scene using his glider. Before the fight could get started, Trent proclaimed that he was going to kill Moon Knight so he could be loved. Then, the third I.E.D. went off and exploded next to Black Spectre and injured him. When Trent was asked who was he supposed to be, he presented himself as Black Spectre. Moon Knight ripped off his mask and explained to him that he didn't want to be loved, because all those close to him suffered and died, and that because he worked alone he had always won. He then left Black Spectre and departed. After a few years, Ryan was recruited by the third Black Spectre along Zodiac to take Moon Knight down. Moon knight first fought Trent thinking him as the current Black Spectre, only to be revealed that he was Trent and was a pawn to the third Black Spectre, Robert Plesko.

ryder.name: Ryder
ryder.species: Human Mutated by consuming the meat of Skrulls who were brainwashed to think they were cows .
ryder.origin: ===Skrull Kill Krew=== The man known only as Ryder was one of a number of people who had unintentionally eaten meat from Skrulls that had been brainwashed into transforming into cows and retaining that form for life. Some of the meat eaten by people transferred the Skrull's adaptable DNA code into the human's cells, resulting in a bizarre condition called Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia, in which these individuals not only gained shape-shifting powers equal to, or greater than, actual Skrulls, but also developed an intense fear or hatred of Skrulls. Only a small number of humans proved susceptible to this syndrome, and most did not survive the initial stages of infection. But several people who proved somewhat longer-lived (though still dying), and Ryder gathered them together (known as Riot, Catwalk, Dice, and Moonstomp), to act out their increasingly irrational impulses to seek out and destroy the ones who did this to them (by "letting" themselves get turned into cows), usually by graphically "blowing away" the Skrulls with high-powered weapons. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative. ===Secret Invasion=== Ryder and Riot returned much later to ferret out more Skrulls. Ryder had kept the other three alive, as heads kept in jars; their Skull infestation has resulted in the loss of their bodies. They encountered the new 3-D Man in the New Mexico desert and saved him from a Skrull posing as 'She-Thing'. Ryder and Riot helped 3-D Man and the Initiative find and kill all the Skrulls infiltrating all the Initiative teams. Moonstomp, Dice, and Catwalk, were able to help track down Skrulls, which allowed the speedsters and teleporters in the Initiative to take the Skrull Kill Krew members and 3-D Man across the country very quickly. After the Skrulls are defeated, Moonstomp, Dice, and Catwalk's heads all died, and Riot reverted to human form, dying also. 3-D Man and Ryder then set out to find and kill any Skrulls that might still be on Earth. He returned to solo adventuring, stalking the remainders of the Skrullian army on Earth, and strongly believing there may be more milk and meat contaminated by Skrull genetics. However, it's implied he may be a Skrull himself: one of the original Skrullian cows able to restore himself to a human appearance, but losing his memory in the process and explaining his superhuman powers with the "Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia."

fields.history: ===Skrull Kill Krew=== The man known only as Ryder was one of a number of people who had unintentionally eaten meat from Skrulls that had been brainwashed into transforming into cows and retaining that form for life. Some of the meat eaten by people transferred the Skrull's adaptable DNA code into the human's cells, resulting in a bizarre condition called Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia, in which these individuals not only gained shape-shifting powers equal to, or greater than, actual Skrulls, but also developed an intense fear or hatred of Skrulls. Only a small number of humans proved susceptible to this syndrome, and most did not survive the initial stages of infection. But several people who proved somewhat longer-lived (though still dying), and Ryder gathered them together (known as Riot, Catwalk, Dice, and Moonstomp), to act out their increasingly irrational impulses to seek out and destroy the ones who did this to them (by "letting" themselves get turned into cows), usually by graphically "blowing away" the Skrulls with high-powered weapons. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative. ===Secret Invasion=== Ryder and Riot returned much later to ferret out more Skrulls. Ryder had kept the other three alive, as heads kept in jars; their Skull infestation has resulted in the loss of their bodies. They encountered the new 3-D Man in the New Mexico desert and saved him from a Skrull posing as 'She-Thing'. Ryder and Riot helped 3-D Man and the Initiative find and kill all the Skrulls infiltrating all the Initiative teams. Moonstomp, Dice, and Catwalk, were able to help track down Skrulls, which allowed the speedsters and teleporters in the Initiative to take the Skrull Kill Krew members and 3-D Man across the country very quickly. After the Skrulls are defeated, Moonstomp, Dice, and Catwalk's heads all died, and Riot reverted to human form, dying also. 3-D Man and Ryder then set out to find and kill any Skrulls that might still be on Earth. He returned to solo adventuring, stalking the remainders of the Skrullian army on Earth, and strongly believing there may be more milk and meat contaminated by Skrull genetics. However, it's implied he may be a Skrull himself: one of the original Skrullian cows able to restore himself to a human appearance, but losing his memory in the process and explaining his superhuman powers with the "Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia."
abilities: Skilled in the use of weapons and unarmed combat.
weaknesses: Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia: He also developed an intense fear and hatred of Skrulls.
weapons: Various weapons he shape shifts his hands into

ryku.name: Ryku
ryku.origin: Ryku was a mere acolyte and disciple of the Speakers of the Living Wind, a conclave of God-Men whom he served, and also a spy for Jolari, high chief of Kwanyi. He witnessed their sacred globe shattered by a Speaker who failed the ritual, and was immediately devoured by the liquid blaze. He was then offered the rank of Speaker by Geyrus, if he could gain knowledge about Conan and Valeria. When Jolari eventually challenged Geyrus, he took the chance to kill him and became the First Speaker himself, allying with the Kwanyi to strike the Ichiribu. With the aid of magic, Ryku saw Dobanpu and a smattering of Ichiribu setting out from their fortress isle. Ryku then managed to summon the Living Wind, but succumb to its unnatural force and died almost instantly.

rynda.name: Rynda
rynda.origin: Rynda, director of the Prenatal Care Center, was among the top geneticists of Attilan, along with her husband Agon, the ruler of the Inhumans' Council of Genetics. thumb|left|300px|Exposed herself and her fetus to the Mists During pregnancy, she and Agon exposed her unborn son to the Terrigen Mists, using her Inhuman powers to prevent undergoing Secondary Terrigenesis while flawlessly directing the Mists unto the foetus, creating one of the most powerful Inhumans ever: Black Bolt. As a result, he was quickly isolated at birth. She later gave birth to Maximus. Like her husband, she was killed when a Kree starship crashed into their laboratory after being downed by Black Bolt.

ryoko sabuki.name: Ryoko Sabuki
ryoko sabuki.origin: ===Known background=== Ryoko Sabuki was the granddaughter of WWII super-heroine Golden Woman. After the death of her sister Ameiko, Ryoko moved to Japan in order to reconnect with the country, and became a celebrity for her two careers, both as a singer and as a super-hero. It is not known either when she discovered her super-human powers (described below) or when she began to use the primary alias of Radiance. She later decided to roll-out in the United States. As she was in Manhattan talking to her new manager Howard Silver, the Watcher's eye detonated, releasing a blast of energy which caused anyone near the explosion radius to discover deep secrets related to them. Through glimpses of the past, Ryoko discovered that the Invaders had the chance to prevent the atom bomb from being dropped in Hiroshima during World War II. Back in Japan, Radiance took an entire S.H.I.E.L.D. facility hostage, and demanded the presence of any of the Invaders. Jim Hammond, the earliest Human Torch, appeared before her. Ryoko revealed to him what she now knew, and demanded him to tell the full story. ====James Hammond's story==== Jim revealed that the United States Army had a plan to use the combined super-human powers of some of the Invaders to form a tsunami to attack the Japanese fleet. However, some islands that were inhabited by innocent people would be part of the collateral damage. Golden Girl refused to put innocent lives at risk, and sabotaged the mission when it was being carried out by her fellow Invaders. The battle between their own took the Invaders to one of the islands and, upon seeing the population they would decimate, they decided to abort the mission. Unbeknownst to them, the said action led the Army to bomb Hiroshima and Nagasaki, which ended up costing many more lives, not least through the delayed effects of radiation poisoning from the bombs's explosions. ===Consequences=== thumb|left|Radiance and the Human Torch Ryoko suffered an emotional breakdown because of the revelation that her own grandmother's actions had indirectly led to the bombings, and she accidentally caused an explosion which destroyed the S.H.I.E.L.D. base. Luckily, the hostage agents were saved when Radiance shielded them at the last second. With the situation settled, the Human Torch escorted Ryoko out of the building, and took the blame of the explosion so Radiance would not be arrested. Right in that moment, a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent reported that the Lord Great Dagora was attacking Tokyo. Radiance invited the Human Torch to help her defeat him.

ryu kobolt.name: Ryu Kobolt
ryu kobolt.origin: Ryu Kobolt was an agent of Feng Huang in Hong Kong. He saved Shakti Haddad from a cyborg tracker at Feng's request and offered Shakti safe haven with Feng's organization. Shakti had run away from her father, the Red Market czar Zail Haddad, who was a rival of Feng Huang's. Feng Huang took pleasure in helping Shakti oppose her father. thumb|left|Architect (Ryu Kobolt) & Cerebra (Shakti Haddad) While they were together, Ryu and Shakti fell in love, but he ultimately left her and Hong Kong behind. Ryu Kobolt was dying of a degenerative disease, and did not want Shakti to watch him suffer. Looking to die on his own terms, Ryu traveled to the radioactive island known as Hellrock, hoping to die in battle with the Mutroids in pit combat. He was rescued from himself by a mutant named Memphis, who got him off Hellrock and convinced Ryu to live for something again. Ryu Kobolt decided to build an Oasis in the deserts of the United States, a peaceful self-sustaining environment that would be open for all people. However, he also decided the corporate world order was irreversibly corrupt. Ryu planned to seal his Oasis and his followers inside their dome and launch a viral missile strike on the rest of the world. Ryu intended to place his followers in cryo-sleep for several centuries emerging only when the virus had cleansed the planet for a new world order to emerge. Before the big sleep, Ryu Kobolt wanted to see Shakti one last time. Now a member of the X-Men known as Cerebra, Ryu arranged for a mutant follower to lead Shakti and the X-Men to the Oasis. Cerebra was unwilling to accept his genocide, however, and soon both Shakti and Memphis turned against Ryu's plots. Ryu died in the Oasis as Cerebra sealed him and the viral missiles inside the domes, saving the rest of the world.

ryuhei kodo.name: Ryuhei Kodo
ryuhei kodo.first_appearance: Tomb of Dracula Presents: Throne of Blood Vol 1 1
ryuhei kodo.origin: A warrior in medieval Japan, Ryuhei Kodo found his clan threatened by the warlord Jakkura (actually a vampire), a mysteriously powerful conqueror who had legions of men at his command, held in sway mostly by fear. Journeying to Jakkaru's encampment with his brother Raizo in the guise of simple peasants, the duo was able to infiltrate his camp, killing his guards and confronting Jakkaru. Enraged, Jakkaru attacked the pair, holding his own before being stabbed through the heart by Ryuhei. Thinking him dead, Ryuhei approached the body hoping to find a personal treasure of Jakkaru's he could show his father, but quickly found that Jakkaru wasn't dead. As Jakkaru sunk his fangs into Ryuhei, Raizo grabbed the first thing he could find, a wooden training sword, and stabbed Jakkaru again, then beheaded the vampire, seemingly killing him. Escaping with his injured brother, the two fled to their clan's home. Over the next few days, Ryuhei's behavior changed, as he spent nights carousing with women in the neighboring village. Confronting Ryuhei over this behavior, Raizo found his brother belligerent and angry that his brother seemingly didn't respect him. Later Raizo found his entire family had turned and had to slay them before confronting Ryuhei who sat calmly in anticipation of the battle. Offering Raizo a chance to join the clan as it gained power, Raizo told his brother he would never choose that path, then battled his brother, eventually being disarmed and held at the point of a sword by Ryuhei. At that point, a piece of the burning roof fell onto Ryuhei, separating the two and setting Ryuhei on fire, and Raizo beheaded him.

ryuki.name: Ryuki
ryuki.origin: Ryuki was a Shinma demon native to Ashurado, the fourth level of the Japanese netherworld of Yomi. In the 1800s, he possessed the body of Hana Yanowa, a woman born into the Shosei Order, a lineage of miko (巫女) Shinto shrine maidens, who turned her back on the Order and began studying dark and forbidden mystic arts. Using Hana's body, Ryuki sought to kill and absorb the souls of enough innocent victims to open a gateway from Ashurado and crossover into the Earth realm in his own physical form. However, in 1864, Ryuki and Hana were confronted by Hana's twin sister Mana (High Priestess of Shosei Order), who trapped the souls of Ryuki and Hana (as well as her own soul) within the jewel of her necklace, the Mark of Mana. thumb|left|200px|Ryuki possessing Hana Yanowa (Earth-616)|Hana Yanowa Decades later, in modern times, the Mark of Mana fell into the possession of Wolverine, who used it to return Mana's soul to her physical body; however, doing so also inadvertently released the souls of Hana and Ryuki. Freed from their prison, Hana and Ryuki reanimated the Shinsengumi (新選組), a force of 11 deadly samurai warriors who were executed as traitors upon the fall of the Tokugawa shogunate, so that they could be used to kill enough innocent victims to open a gateway from Ashurado and the Earth realm. Although Wolverine defeated the undead Shinsengumi, Hana and Ryuki still opened a gateway from Ashurado to Earth. Wolverine and Mana defeated the demons, and then Wolverine used his gold-coated claws to defeat Ryuki (exploiting the demon's weakness to gold, which had previously been revealed to Mana by the Amatsu-Kami Inari), while Mana killed Hana with her dagger.

Freed from their prison, Hana and Ryuki reanimated the Shinsengumi (新選組), a force of 11 deadly samurai warriors who were executed as traitors upon the fall of the Tokugawa shogunate, so that they could be used to kill enough innocent victims to open a gateway from Ashurado and the Earth realm. Although Wolverine defeated the undead Shinsengumi, Hana and Ryuki still opened a gateway from Ashurado to Earth. Wolverine and Mana defeated the demons, and then Wolverine used his gold-coated claws to defeat Ryuki (exploiting the demon's weakness to gold, which had previously been revealed to Mana by the Amatsu-Kami Inari), while Mana killed Hana with her dagger.

ra morgana.name: Râ Morgana
ra morgana.origin: ===Origin=== Râ Morgana was the daughter of the would-be-high priestess of a priesthood in the mountains, and of the Cimmerian adventurer Conan, who have saved her from a sorcerer, and to whom she had offered herself in a night of passion. Conan offered the priestess to leave with him but she refused. The intervention of Conan in the adventure was hidden to the priesthood, and she stated that she and battled the wizard alone and escaped with the aid of the gods. The next month, she performed a sacred ceremony in honor of the gods of fertility, afterwards spoke of visions and that a god had lain with her, and gave birth to a "holy child", Râ Morgana. She came to regret not having fled with Conan, and kept on looking north to the mountains. ===High priestess=== The woman became the all-mother and high priestess of her priesthood. She taught Râ Morgana the Woman-Magic she had been taught. Growing up, Râ Morgana was hated by Té Kortinea, an ugly and hateful priestess. At 20, she dated a man, whom she loved, and who wanted to go away with her. Caught embraced with a man, she was brought to her mother, while the man escaped and promised to return. Té Kortinea wanted her punished and the man ambushed, but was sent away. Alone, the high priestess told Râ Morgana of her own encounter with Conan for her to have some perspective on the choice of leaving or not, telling her of her true father by the way. Râ Morgana decided to flee with her man. The high priestess arranged for her daughter to walk out through the front gate. Té Kortinéa was outraged by Râ Morgana, and threatened the high priestess' position for her doings, but she did not care, as she sat upon her throne, looking north to the mountains, thinking to maybe go there someday soon.

rkkva.name: Røkkva
rkkva.species: Anti-life entity spawned at the beginning of the universe.
rkkva.origin: The Røkkva was a primordial anti-life entity spawned from the essence of the Anti-All near the beginning of the universe, roaming the cosmos and mindlessly seeking out and either destroying or corrupting all life that it came across. As life spread throughout the universe, the Røkkva grew increasingly powerful and destructive. Eventually, a king named Øde sought to claim the Røkkva's power for himself and bonded to it, becoming one of the most powerful beings in the Ten Realms. However, the Røkkva corrupted Øde, twisting him into an evil shadow of his former self and blackening his body into a soulless husk that was neither truly alive nor truly dead. Øde's subjects eventually rebelled against him and slew him with a weapon made from the sacred white wood of Fiererheim - the one material capable of purging the Røkkva. The Røkkva was imprisoned in a tomb deep in the Barren Mountains of Jotunheim, the entrance sealed with ancient magicks deliberately lost to time. Øde's corpse was buried nearby, and the subsequent All-Fathers of Asgard were charged with ensuring that neither one of them was disturbed. Untold eons later, Tyr Odinson learned of the Røkkva's existence and sought to claim it for himself. Unable to break the seal on his own, he stole Øde's corpse and attempted to resurrect him with the sap of Yggdrasill, intending for the new Valkyrie's Undrjarn to manifest a weapon made of white wood in order to kill Øde, which Tyr would then steal and use to break the seal. Tyr's plan backfired when Yggdrasil's sap failed to resurrect Øde - whose soul had been consumed by the Røkkva - and instead caused the eldritch darkness festering inside him to metastasize into a horde of life-draining monsters. Thor Odinson, Tyr's younger brother and the All-Father of Asgard, attempted to destroy Øde's corpse with Mjolnir but was infected by the Røkkva. Manifesting a spear made of white wood, Valkyrie was able to destroy Øde's corpse, but was left too exhausted by her battle with the corrupted Thor to stop Tyr from stealing Undrjarn. Returning to Jotunheim, Tyr and Thor broke the seal on the Røkkva despite Loki attempting to intervene. The Røkkva submitted to Tyr's control as long as he possessed the white wood spear, but quickly began to eat away at his mind and soul as it once did to Øde. Tyr then used the Røkkva to attack Asgard and infect the Asgardians. Jane went toe-to-toe against Tyr, but he stabbed her with Undrjarn. This however, allowed Jane to take back her weapon, becoming Valkyrie again and using Asgard's light to weaken the Røkkva. After Tyr's defeat, Jane brought the Røkkva back to its prison. Feeling sorry for it, Jane tried to talk to the Røkkva before locking it up, but she got no response from it.

s h i v a.name: S.H.I.V.A.
s h i v a.origin: Shiva was the Weapon X Program's fail-safe against discovery. Although agents traditionally had their memories altered or wiped before placing them back into society, the possibility was contemplated that they might somehow learn of the Program anyway. If Program security was deemed compromised, Shiva was activated to eliminate the Program's subjects and ensure Weapon X's anonymity. After Wolverine inadvertently activated the Shiva program, the robot made several attempts on the lives of Weapon X test subjects. Years later, a Shiva android was reactivated by the program when Wolverine began further researching his origins. During the fight, Wolverine sliced Shiva apart cutting it in half with a single blow using the Muramasa Blade. Later research into the remains of the robot has shown that it was not cut, but rather "sliced, on the molecular level".

saba hamud.name: Saba Hamud
saba hamud.origin: Saba Hamud was the brother of Arabian Prince Ali Hamud who built a home in the Belgian Congo during the 1940s. After the start of World War II, Saba's brother allied himself with the Nazis, building an airfield on his land so that Nazi planes could refuel on their way to attacking British colonies in Africa. Saba silently protested against this but secretly bide his time for the right time to strike. When the jungle hero Ka-Zar was captured and thrown in Ali's torture pit, Saba rescued him from a Leopard and pulled him through a secret passageway. Explaining who he is and his position to Ka-Zar, he helped Ka-Zar escape while setting up explosives below the property. As Ka-Zar freed himself and escaped aboard a Nazi plane, Saba detonated the explosives sacrificing his life to destroy his brother's home and slew all the Nazis within.

sabarr.name: Sabarr
sabarr.origin: In the year 1995 of Earth-4040, Sabarr was the ruler of a group of raiders who would send some of their men to attack a fort being built by Breeze Barton. Seeking to rebuild society, Barton would stop the thieves attack and send two back to their leader to invite them to join his mission. Sabarr would be furious and refuse and lead his men to attack. During their initial attack, Sabarr and his men would capture Breeze and his companion Ann Barclay. However, Breeze and Ann would break free and return to the battle. In the final conflict with Breeze, Sabarr would be blown up by a grenade tossed by the hero, killing him. With their leader dead, the thieves would surrender and join Barton's cause.

sabbatha.origin: Sabbatha was a former sorceress who lived in a crumbling walled mansion where the Avenue of the Sea's Desire met the Stygian Cemetery. Like her daughter Rosina, she seemed to have an unhealthy affection for a magical artifact known as the Tear of Nitocris. When her precious necklace and Rosina were taken away by a couple of simianthros, she begged Conan to find them and bring them back.

saber.name: Saber
saber.origin: When Mandarin sent a wave of Dreadnoughts to destroy the Three Gorges Dam in China, Iron Man went to help, and he found the help of The Dynasty, the new group of militarized Chinese superheroes. Among their ranks is Saber, who possesses two energy lightsabers. The Chinese army decided to use jets to explode the Dam, so although they would lose it anyway, they could at least destroy the enemy. Then the Dynasty left the scene in a special aircraft. When Tony Stark was kidnapped by the Mandarin and forced to create new weapons for him, the Dynasty was contacted by Tony's friends Pepper Potts and Bethany Cabe of Resilient for help to rescue Tony. The cavalry arrived just in time when Iron Man was fighting Mandarin and his Titanomechs, which were destroyed by the efforts of the heroes. The Dynasty disbanded following the death of The Star during Thanos' invasion. However, Saber accepted Weather Witch's invitation to be part of a new team she had been tasked to assemble and lead, S.P.E.A.R.'s Ascendants along with the Weather Witch.

saber hagen.name: Saber Hagen
saber hagen.origin: ===Origin=== The Red Dog Project, led by Dr. Dorn, was made to create super-soldiers who were later used during the Pollution Wars. At the end, most of the Red Dog were terminated by the Project. Saber Hagen was born from two passive Red Dog's genes carriers, legally Degens but less mutated, who were allowed to procreate and eventually gained right at the end of their copyrights. However, Alchemax passed through those legal aspects to regain their genetics stock. To protect their son, the Hagen make him leave their house, before they were captured by Eco Central Gene Police agents, and used by the Dr. Dorn as experimentation subjects. The Hagen contested their arrestation and asked help from their neighbours, which don't react. Saber was taken in the Degen Hostel by the pitiful Matt Axel. left|359px|thumb|Matt Axel taking care of Saber after his parents abduction When he came to age, he left the Hostel, and crossed the way of a Total-Reality tripped man who was threatening a woman, without any reactions from the crowd. He fought the drug-addict, save the woman and finally murdered all the people for their reactions of admiration and their previous inaction. On this action, he took the name of Public Enemy. ===Public Enemy File=== He crossed the way of a Eco Police arrestation of two Degens. Again, witnessing the inaction of the people, who claimed to be powerless against the laws, he killed both police and crowd, and carried the Degens to the Degen Hostel. His mass-murdering came to the ears of Jake Gallows and the Public Eye. During a criminal targeting, the Punisher was approached by Public Enemy. Saber once again terminated numerous inactive civilians, and Jake tried to kill him. Matt Axel tried to convince both Jake and Saber to discuss, but the Punisher personality had the led on Jake's body and he tried to fight him, intending to terminate the Degen, and then Matt Axel. The Red Dog was upon to win against the Punisher, but the crowd finally choose to self-defend, forming a mob and killing the Public Enemy, who stated he had accomplished his mission. ===Once-In-A-Lifetime Prequel=== Unbeknownst to the Punisher and Matt Axel, Saber survived, fighting against the mob who turned on herself, crazy, and who was attacked by the Public Eye's anti-riot cops. He gave up his Public Enemy identity and tried to live a normal life, working at Don's Cyber Mart, but when his kind boss, Don, was shot by a gang in his shop, he neutralized them, and went out, to be acclaimed by another crowd of admirative watchers. Saber give them his speech of disgust, about killing massive crowds to spread his stand-up message but frightened them. He left so, thinking of or not he should took again the role of the Public Enemy.

sablat.name: Sablat
sablat.origin: Sabat defected the Turanian army and joined the Bahari Kozaks. Following Shenkov's death, Sablat proposed Conan as their new hetman. After the battle against the Free Companions, Sablat and Vanov were ordered by Conan to take care of Isparana. Later that night, he got on famously with Zula and Turghol. Sablat then ventured north with Conan and Zula to ally with the Kezanks. When the Cimmerian set out to Yaralet, Sablat was ordered to remain at the camp with Zula.

sable manfredi.name: Sable Manfredi
sable manfredi.origin: Sable Manfredi is the daughter of the crimelord Silvio Manfredi. She was once in a relationship with Hammerhead when he worked for her father. Ever since her father was imprisoned, she has been operating his declining empire. Silver Sable participated in the auction bid for a chip that had plans to build of army of super-rhino mercenaries alongside Hammerhead, Doc Ock, and Roderick Kingsley, an owner of a perfume company. However, she attacked Kingsley after he won the chip, when Rhino and Spider-Man interfered. She reluctantly teamed up with her ex boyfriend Hammerhead to defeat them. Silver Sable was defeated, but escaped. Later, she attends the Valentine Day's summit with her father Silvio Manfredi to decide the crime scene in New York, but Hammerhead tranquilized her, making her unconscious. While he blames it on Tombstone, starting a three-way fight between Tombstone, Doc Ock, and Silvio Manfredi. She later woke up and was greeted by Hammerhead, who told her she had to be nice to him, leaving her trembling as he left. She managed to escape once again, leaving her father to be arrested.

sabretooth.name: Sabretooth
sabretooth.origin: ===Early Years=== ====Origin==== When Victor Creed's mutation first manifested, he accidentally killed his brother over a piece of pie. His father confined him to a cellar and would systematically pull out Victor's "devil teeth" in an attempt to purge the boy of his "demons". Victor was chained like an animal in the family cellar for years until one day he chewed off his own hand in order to break free, subsequently murdering his father. Although he would later claim to have killed his mother as well, he actually spared her, and made sure she lived a comfortable life, until she was diagnosed with cancer and confined to a hospital, where she was killed by a member of the Red Right Hand. Freed from his parents, Victor was unleashed upon society. At age thirteen, he reportedly rampaged across three Canadian provinces and killed at least three police officers. According to Creed, he remained in Canada and, at about fifteen, worked for the railroad, laying down rail from Calgary up to the Yukon. Among the workers on the line was a belligerent older man who delighted in picking on the teenage Creed. Though the man "had a hundred pounds on him", Creed gutted him from crotch to Adam's apple with his claws. ====Meeting Wolverine==== For years, Victor maintained an annual tradition of torturing his younger brother Saul on his birthday, until one day his sister, Clara, told him that his brother had died and was now free from him. Victor quickly learned that his brother had died at the hands of a man named Logan. He then decided to get his revenge against his brother's killer and went after him. In 1909, he discovered that a serial killer had killed three people in as many months. After finding an unconscious Logan in the middle of a crime scene, Victor believed that Logan was the mysterious serial killer the police were after. Before the police arrived, Victor snatched the unconscious Logan from the crime scene and took him to the Ravencroft Institute in Westchester County where he was working as Nathaniel Essex's assistant. Essex lobotomized Logan, which put him in a comatose state. He then proceeded to cut Logan's left arm off, while Victor looked on in delight. One of the doctors, Claudia Russell, was able to free Logan and tried to help him escape, but on their way out the duo was confronted by Victor. Victor threw Logan away and confronted Claudia, but Logan's healing factor kicked in and started to heal his brain, awakening him from his comatose state. Logan thrust his claws into Victor's head through his lower jaw, but Victor was able to throw him aside once again. Knowing that Logan had no chance against Victor in his condition, Claudia begged him to escape while Victor was injured. Despite still being in a feral state because of his brain injury, Logan understood and agreed to escape. Before Victor could go after Logan, Claudia revealed to him that Logan was not responsible for the murders, which had happened during a full moon. She was actually the killer, but had committed the murders by accident. She then transformed into a werewolf and attacked the injured Victor. Victor was saved by Essex, resulting in Claudia's capture. Victor and Essex later experimented on Claudia and killed her. ====Mad Dog Murphy==== In 1909, Creed, disillusioned with Mister Sinister, befriended Fisk at the Ravencroft Institute and escaped to Five Points, New York City, where they killed Brick Barton and took the name "Mad Dog Murphy". Creed became Fisk's enforcer taking back control of the Gangs of New York, but tensions escalated when he fought Sir Marmaduke Dix, a Crocodilian avatar of Sobek, sparking a shadow war against Fisk. After falling out with Fisk, Creed formed an alliance and relationship with Dragonfire taking control of the Five Points, but their reign ended when Dix killed Dragonfire. Creed later confronted Dix at Dreamland, where their battle destroyed the park and he was forced to return to Mister Sinister. He had made plans to go to the Savage Land and give Dragonfire a proper burial but immediately put them on hold to go after Logan in Niagara Falls when he saw a newspaper article about his whereabouts. ===Romulus=== In the following years, Victor - now known as Sabretooth - supposedly joined the organization of the mysterious Romulus, and moved to Tokyo, Japan, where he murdered several women. But one night during one of his rampages, he once again faced Logan. Logan had been extorted by the ninja sect known as the Hand into fighting Sabretooth. During their fight, Logan was able to cut off one of Sabretooth's hands with his sword. Sabretooth was able to reattach it thanks to his healing factor, to the surprise of Logan. Sabretooth was then defeated by Logan, who impaled him with his sword. fields.history: ===Early Years=== ====Origin==== When Victor Creed's mutation first manifested, he accidentally killed his brother over a piece of pie. His father confined him to a cellar and would systematically pull out Victor's "devil teeth" in an attempt to purge the boy of his "demons". Victor was chained like an animal in the family cellar for years until one day he chewed off his own hand in order to break free, subsequently murdering his father. Although he would later claim to have killed his mother as well, he actually spared her, and made sure she lived a comfortable life, until she was diagnosed with cancer and confined to a hospital, where she was killed by a member of the Red Right Hand. Freed from his parents, Victor was unleashed upon society. At age thirteen, he reportedly rampaged across three Canadian provinces and killed at least three police officers. According to Creed, he remained in Canada and, at about fifteen, worked for the railroad, laying down rail from Calgary up to the Yukon. Among the workers on the line was a belligerent older man who delighted in picking on the teenage Creed. Though the man "had a hundred pounds on him", Creed gutted him from crotch to Adam's apple with his claws. ====Meeting Wolverine==== For years, Victor maintained an annual tradition of torturing his younger brother Saul on his birthday, until one day his sister, Clara, told him that his brother had died and was now free from him. Victor quickly learned that his brother had died at the hands of a man named Logan. He then decided to get his revenge against his brother's killer and went after him. In 1909, he discovered that a serial killer had killed three people in as many months. After finding an unconscious Logan in the middle of a crime scene, Victor believed that Logan was the mysterious serial killer the police were after. Before the police arrived, Victor snatched the unconscious Logan from the crime scene and took him to the Ravencroft Institute in Westchester County where he was working as Nathaniel Essex's assistant. Essex lobotomized Logan, which put him in a comatose state. He then proceeded to cut Logan's left arm off, while Victor looked on in delight. One of the doctors, Claudia Russell, was able to free Logan and tried to help him escape, but on their way out the duo was confronted by Victor. Victor threw Logan away and confronted Claudia, but Logan's healing factor kicked in and started to heal his brain, awakening him from his comatose state. Logan thrust his claws into Victor's head through his lower jaw, but Victor was able to throw him aside once again. Knowing that Logan had no chance against Victor in his condition, Claudia begged him to escape while Victor was injured. Despite still being in a feral state because of his brain injury, Logan understood and agreed to escape. Before Victor could go after Logan, Claudia revealed to him that Logan was not responsible for the murders, which had happened during a full moon. She was actually the killer, but had committed the murders by accident. She then transformed into a werewolf and attacked the injured Victor. Victor was saved by Essex, resulting in Claudia's capture. Victor and Essex later experimented on Claudia and killed her. ====Mad Dog Murphy==== In 1909, Creed, disillusioned with Mister Sinister, befriended Fisk at the Ravencroft Institute and escaped to Five Points, New York City, where they killed Brick Barton and took the name "Mad Dog Murphy". Creed became Fisk's enforcer taking back control of the Gangs of New York, but tensions escalated when he fought Sir Marmaduke Dix, a Crocodilian avatar of Sobek, sparking a shadow war against Fisk. After falling out with Fisk, Creed formed an alliance and relationship with Dragonfire taking control of the Five Points, but their reign ended when Dix killed Dragonfire. Creed later confronted Dix at Dreamland, where their battle destroyed the park and he was forced to return to Mister Sinister. He had made plans to go to the Savage Land and give Dragonfire a proper burial but immediately put them on hold to go after Logan in Niagara Falls when he saw a newspaper article about his whereabouts. ===Romulus=== In the following years, Victor - now known as Sabretooth - supposedly joined the organization of the mysterious Romulus, and moved to Tokyo, Japan, where he murdered several women. But one night during one of his rampages, he once again faced Logan. Logan had been extorted by the ninja sect known as the Hand into fighting Sabretooth. During their fight, Logan was able to cut off one of Sabretooth's hands with his sword. Sabretooth was able to reattach it thanks to his healing factor, to the surprise of Logan. Sabretooth was then defeated by Logan, who impaled him with his sword. But before Logan could finish him, their fight was stopped by Romulus who knocked Logan out. thumb|left|Sabretooth facing Logan after the death of Silver Fox Under Romulus' orders, Sabretooth then tracked Logan to a frontier c
fields.personality: Sabretooth is a vicious killer who delights in inflicting pain and misery. Like his rival Wolverine, Sabretooth has an animalistic side, but whereas Wolverine fights to control himself and his murderous rage, Sabretooth has no qualms in giving in to his base instincts. He gives himself over wholeheartedly to the beast within and indulges in every vile or murderous impulse that strikes him. While Sabretooth has been part of teams such as Team X and the Marauders in the past, he is wholly self-serving and will readily betray nearly anyone to save his own skin or achieve his own goals. While Sabretooth may appear to be nothing more than a brute, he is in fact devilishly clever and a master manipulator, able to expertly maneuver others into situations favorable to him or provoke them in ways that will throw them off balance and give him an edge. Despite his callous and psycopathic exterior, Sabretooth carried the weight of a long and hard life deep inside, both the traumas he had suffered and those he had inflicted on his victims. He knew full well that the world would be a better place without him and that he deserved eternal damnation for his actions, but could ultimately only abide the suffering inside him by inflicting it on others. While he has shown flashes of goodness and has at times cared genuinely for a select few, he has for the most part rejected any opportunities at redemption, determined to give the world exactly what they see in him; a monster.

fields.notes: Mister Sinister created clones of all of the Marauders using genetic material he had gathered from all of them. Sabretooth's cloning partner in the Marauders is Riptide. At one point, Sinister claimed he was unable to clone Sabretooth anymore, and wanted another genetic sample. However, he later managed to clone vast troops of Sabretooth Hounds while in Sinister London. Creed has been stated to be a psychopath and a sociopath. Sabretooth seems to have comic awareness, as he knew that Deadpool was based on , a DC Comics mercenary. Sabretooth has a tradition of attacking Wolverine once a year on Logan's birthday.
fields.trivia: Sabretooth also speaks ,; he reveals this it in a conversation with Omega Red, Sabretooth says this when asking Omega Red if he knows that he can speak Russian too in Weapon X Vol 3 18. Sabretooth actually made his debut as an Iron Fist villain. The DC Comics super-villain of The is based on Sabretooth. Sabretooth's physical strength has been artificially enhanced at least twice. Sabretooth received his first strength enhancement from his son, Graydon Creed, during the mini-series Sabretooth: Death Hunt. Sabretooth's strength was further enhanced later after joining the latest incarnation of the Weapon X Program. Although Sabretooth was a proud killer, his animal tendencies sometimes overwhelmed him. To stay in control, he forced a telepath named Birdy to routinely give him "The Glow", a psychic sedative effect that helped manage his animal side. When Birdy was killed, the withdrawal symptoms made Creed's animal side more uncontrollable than ever, and he sought psionic treatment from the X-Men. After Wolverine poked a claw through his brain, however, Creed's personality regenerated as a purer fusion of animal and man, making him at least temporarily more resistant to psychic powers, although both Jean Gray and Professor Xavier were able to eventually overcome this. During , Sabretooth developed a close relationship with Monet St. Croix which writer Cullen Bunn confirmed was a torturous love. Before the cancellation of Uncanny X-Men, Cullen Bunn had a larger story planned for Sabretooth's fall back into villainy, which was going to be served as a metaphor for Alzheimer's, which Bunn had lost his father to.

sabrina cole.origin: Sabrina Cole was a federal prosecutor, and one of her cases was to get a confession from the arrested drug trafficker Terrence Barbur, but to prevent Barbur from confessing, Elektra was hired to eliminate him and she did it by poisoning, with a poison which was absorbed by the skin, the paper on which he was writing the confession only that, after Barbur had died, the paper also came into contact with Sabrina who, even though the poison had lost effectiveness, still led to Sabrina's death over a painful fortnight and the day before she was supposed to marry the wealthy lawyer Jeremy Locke.

sabrina morrel.name: Sabrina Morrel
sabrina morrel.origin: A French-Japanese woman living in San Francisco, Sabrina "Bree" Morell had a brother, Paul Morell, with whom she kept in touch. Both their parents had died a long time ago by the time Sabrina and Paul were adults. Sabrina Morrel joined the San Francisco Police Department, becoming a detective lieutenant and supervisor running the homicide division. With long working hours and dedication, she came to consider herself an excellent professional in her field and she had the best arrest and conviction record in her department, earning her a reputation even outside the police department, including lawyers and journalists. While the media called her "homicide's top investigator" in a flattering attempt to get her declarations, Morrel typically got rid of the press without revealing any juicy tidbit of data. thumb|left|Morrel had a rarely-seen yakuza tattoo on her back However, she found herself at odds with the bureaucracy that prevent her from really helping people while criminals were allowed to roam free. Famously impatient, she came into contact with the Dragon Clan, a Yakuza gang (thus technically organized crime) which, following the original precepts of their clans, strived to protect the helpless against those who would abuse of them, waging a clandestine war against other criminal organizations, including other Yakuza gangs. Dragon Clan Ieyasu "Sam" Imura, who had built a secret headquarters for the Clan under Alcatraz Island, showed Morrel how to bend the rules to achieve the results she wanted, without worrying about jurisdictions, following only their honor code that allowed them to answer violence with violence, but never starting it and always working to save lives, thus they considered themselves the protectors of San Francisco. Imura also became Morrel's teacher and superior, and earned her love in a romantic way (thou it is unclear whether this was reciprocal). Now a samurai, Morrel's backs was tattooed with an ornate dragon, a Yakuza mark that she kept mostly hidden (thou she was allowed to approach others and offer them to join the Clan). Imura often reprimanded Morrel for her impatience, which was considered an important defect; sometimes, Imura sent the Clan on missions that required fighting, but he purposely left Morrel behind, even if she would have preferred to join them. As Morrel was particularly good in several skills, she joined Chou Shan-Liu's dojo, apparently as a teacher. ===Contact with Spider-Woman=== thumb|left|As a police officer, Morrel went after suspect David Ishima... thumb|right|...but also tried to help him. Morrel was assigned to investigate the homicide of Tim Walsh, site boss of the project to build the 45-story-tall Carillon Towers, and who had been found dead, supposedly by an industrial accident. Actually, the tower, project of the corrupt would-be crime lord General Nguyen Ngoc Coy, had multiple illegal modifications, and Walsh's task was to prevent the building inspectors from discovering them, but crew boss David Ishima was being overly curious and, after a public argument the day before, Walsh had fired him to protect him. Secretly, however, Walsh was working with the FBI and, when Coy discovered that, he had his goon Death-Stroke murder Walsh during the night by throwing him from the upper floor. When Walsh's body was found, Morrel followed the trail she knew of, Ishima, and went to look for him at her home in 1 Yarbro Court, asking him to accompany her to identify her body. Ishima was at that time with his girlfriend, private investigator Jessica Drew (and secretly the superheroine Spider-Woman), who insisted on going with them to the scene, suspecting that Morrel had set his sights on Ishima, and that Ishima was innocent. Once they entered the building under construction, after Morrel got rid of the journalists, Ishima effectively identified the body and told Morrel what he knew; but when Morrel asked her where she had been that morning, Drew told her that she should get a lawyer. Morrel allowed Ishima to leave, suggesting that he was a suspect in Walsh's death. Although the evidence was circumstantial, Ishima's lawyer, John DeLuca, saw that Morrel had a strong case against Ishima, and worse still, Ishima was reluctant to accept help from DeLuca or Drew. After a warrant for Ishima's arrest was issued, Morrel approached Ishima in the street and offered her help, recommending him to join the Dragon Clan, but Ishima openly rejected this; Drew spied on this encounter, not getting all the information but discovering potential links of Morrel with the Yakuza (and also discovering later that, at that point, Morell was supposed to immediately arrest Ishima on sight). After Spider-Woman captured Death-Stroke and obtained proofs that Death-Stroke had been the murderer, Morrel collaborated with DeLuca and Drew to exonerate Ishima, and Judge Elizabeth Lynn eventually dismissed all charges against him at the San Francisco City Hall. She believed her parents would have been aghast at her life should they would still be alive. Still, she was in contact and in good terms with her brother Paul. Although she claimed to hate vigilantes (as she told Spider-Woman), she was secretly a vigilante herself (At that time, she was probably just trying to get in Spider-Woman's mind) and, when the X-Men visited San Francisco, she openly sided with them and offered them her friendship. When the X-Men used Alcatraz Island as their hideout, it may have been through Morell's mediation, as she knew of the Clan's secret base there. Unused to superhuman beings, she was astounded when she say Dazzler using her mutant powers. She disliked cats.

sabu.name: Sabu
sabu.origin: Sabu was a member of the Winzeldorf circus where he lived and worked together with Nightcrawler, Jimaine Szardos, and Margali Szardos for many years. He was a master aerialist and trapeze artist and trained Kurt and Jimaine from their earliest childhood. When Kurt Wagner decided to leave the circus, Sabu asked Jimaine if she would allow him to stand in for her in Nightcrawler's final performance. He always considered Kurt as his master pupil and Jimaine granted him his wish. During the show, Sabu's trapeze snapped. Kurt couldn't save him by teleporting and Sabu fell to the ground and died. It was later revealed that his death was magically caused by Margali Szardos who took his life as a sacrifice in order to force her daughter Jimaine to follow the tradition of the Winding Way.

He was a master aerialist and trapeze artist and trained Kurt and Jimaine from their earliest childhood. When Kurt Wagner decided to leave the circus, Sabu asked Jimaine if she would allow him to stand in for her in Nightcrawler's final performance. He always considered Kurt as his master pupil and Jimaine granted him his wish. During the show, Sabu's trapeze snapped. Kurt couldn't save him by teleporting and Sabu fell to the ground and died. It was later revealed that his death was magically caused by Margali Szardos who took his life as a sacrifice in order to force her daughter Jimaine to follow the tradition of the Winding Way.
abilities: Sabu was a master aerialist and trapeze .

saburo yoshida.name: Saburo Yoshida
saburo yoshida.origin: Saburo Yashida was a Japanese delegate to the United Nations who came to New York to dedicate a monument to the youth of the world. He was attacked by Sunfire, and even though he was saved by the X-Men, the monument was destroyed. Saburo, having discovered the identity of the attacker, tried to stop his son from a second attack, this time on the U.S. Congress, but was shot and killed by his brother Tomo who was, in turn, killed by Sunfire in retaliation.

sachiko.name: Sachiko
sachiko.origin: Sachiko was a Yakuza working for the Oyabun Kimura in Madripoor. She picked on the presence of the android Albert through the face-recognition system of the Madripoor International Airport, which misidentified him as Wolverine, who had once killed Kimura's Aniki, Dai Kumo. Because of this, Kimura sent his special enforcers after Albert. When Albert later visited Kimura's base of operations, the Sovereign Hotel, to retrieve the head of his partner Elsie-Dee, Sachiko and Kimura cleared up that he wasn't Wolverine. Kimura still sent his men after Albert since he had killed the enforcers previously sent after him. Albert forced his way into Kimura's office. In the process, Sachiko tried to fight Albert, but he effortlessly swatted her away. Sachiko joined Kimura and rest of the Yakuza in Madripoor in attacking the androids to avenge the Yakuza's honor with Sachiko stating that she wanted to use Albert's head as a bowling ball for slapping her. She and other gang members fired upon the androids, but Albert used his getaway vehicle to ram Kimura's limo. As Elsie-Die tried to attack Kimura with a chainsaw, Sachiko fired upon Elsie-Die with a gun but did little damage. Kimura and the androids eventually made peace after Elsie-Dee erased Kimura's bookkeeping data in her memory banks and Albert sacrificed one of his fingers, and Kimura helped the androids escape Madripoor.

sack.name: Sack
sack.origin: ===Gene Nation=== When the mentally unstable Mikhail Rasputin flooded the Morlock Tunnels, many were believed dead. However, at the last instant, Mikhail used his powers to open a portal into a parallel dimension dubbed The Hill. In this dimension, time moved at a faster rate, and even though it was a manner of months in the main Marvel Universe, it had been between 10-20 years on the Hill. The members of Gene Nation reappeared on Earth-616. Their mission was to destroy one hundred humans for every Morlock life that had been lost. Sack and Vessel were the first members to show themselves, killing a number of civilians at a nightclub. Sack had suffocated a coroner and an innocent bystander when the X-Men arrived. They battled with Wolverine, Storm, Cannonball, and later Beast, and were hardly fazed by their show of force. Finding their luck changing, the two Gene Nationals fled. Later, on the anniversary of the Mutant Massacre, a horrific event in which Mr. Sinister's henchmen, the Marauders, killed many Morlocks, a team of X-Men and the Morlock Callisto confronted an attack group from Gene Nation including Sack, threatening the lives of several civilians by attaching incendiary devices to them that were regulated by Marrow's heartbeat. Seeing it as the only way of stopping the terrorist, Storm ripped out Marrow's heart. Defeated, Callisto took Sack, along with the remaining members of Gene Nation, back to The Hill. A few months later, Storm was kidnapped by Mikhail and taken to The Hill. Once there she had to fight her way to the top of the hill where Mikhail lived, where she successfully overpowered him. Sack was one of the team that successfully reached the top, yet he had decided to take on the moniker of "Glass". Having won the victory, Storm forced Mikhail to take all of the people living on The Hill back to the real world. In an effort to give the mutants a new start, she settled them in a village outside of her home town in Africa. ===M-Day=== Sack was one of the few mutants that was unaffected by the Scarlet Witch's tampering on M-Day, and was next seen on the grounds of the Xavier Institute as one of the 198. He was seen associating with former Gene National Fever Pitch and former Morlock Erg, and almost incited a riot against their Sentinel "protectors". If not for the intervention of Mister M, it could have escalated into a bloody battle. When O*N*E* offered to let the mutants into Salem Center in exchange for being implanted with "tracking" chips, Sack was one of the mutants that had it implanted. When the device's true purpose was revealed he attempted to remove the device, discovering that he couldn't and it was bonded to his skull. Fortunately Mr. M, who did not have one implanted, removed Sack's along with everyone else's. ===Utopia and Second Coming=== Sack later made his way west, showing up on Utopia where he attempted to take control of a corner of the island before being stopped by Psylocke, Dazzler, and several of the younger members of the X-Men. Sack was killed by a Nimrod during Second Coming. He was later confirmed to be living on the mutant-only nation of Krakoa, presumably resurrected by The Five.

sacred one.name: Sacred One
sacred one.origin: The Sacred One was the leader of a voodoo cult that operated outside of New York City from a castle. One night he sent some of his minions to capture a young girl for sacrifice to the fire god that they worshiped. In doing so, they alerted the attention of the Angel, who came to the girl's rescue. Tracking the girl down, the Angel confronted the Sacred One and interrupted the sacrifice. After The Angel avoidied the Sacred One's hypnosis and one of his traps, the cult leader became frightened of the Angel and — ironically – stumbled into his own trap door falling to his apparent death. With the Sacred One seemingly slain, his followers under his hypnotic control jumped into the same trap.

sacrificer.name: Sacrificer
sacrificer.origin: Sacrificer was one of the Martian Masters human servants, who worked in Death-Birth in preparing human children to be eaten by the Martian. Atalon brought the pregnant Eve 3,301 in order to obtain her child. Killraven and his Freeman broke into Death-Birth and knocked out Atalon and rescued both Adam and Eve. After he and Atalon discovered the dead Masters, they rallied the Death Breeders into chasing them down, and watched as Death-Birth exploded. He tracked down the group and after his men were killed during a fight with Killraven.

sadae tsumura.name: Sadae Tsumura
sadae tsumura.first_appearance: Ghost Rider/Blaze: Spirits of Vengeance Vol 1 2
sadae tsumura.origin: When her sister, Steel Wind was left insensate after being exposed to the mystical 'hellfire' of the demonic hero Ghost Rider, Sadae Tsumura made a deal with Centurious so that he would restore her sister, while turning Sadae into a cyborg called Steel Vengeance who would serve him. Steel Vengeance went on to clash with Ghost Rider again, but when she failed to kill him, Centurious murdered her in revenge.

saddam abed dasem.name: Saddam Abed Dasem
saddam abed dasem.origin: Saddam Abed Dasem was a high‑ranking Hydra associate operating out of Baghdad, where he maintained both political influence and access to advanced weaponry. His activities drew the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D., prompting the agency to assign Elektra Natchios to assassinate him. Although Elektra eliminated several Hydra operatives who had detected her presence, Dasem himself remained out of reach, protected by layers of deception and misdirection. As S.H.I.E.L.D. continued its pursuit, internal complications arose. Agent Molly Stiles secretly approached Hydra and Dasem, informing them that S.H.I.E.L.D. intended to use Elektra to steal a container holding the Scorpio Key—an artifact the agency had no authorization to seize. This intelligence allowed Dasem to manipulate both Hydra and S.H.I.E.L.D., using each as a decoy while advancing his own agenda. During the escalating conflict in Iraq, Dasem exploited the chaos and the global media blackout to activate the Scorpio Key. Agent King eventually realized that Dasem had orchestrated the entire situation, using Hydra as a smokescreen to distract S.H.I.E.L.D. and the United Nations from his true objective. Elektra infiltrated Dasem’s palace as military jets flew over Baghdad and S.H.I.E.L.D. forces clashed with Hydra outside. Fighting her way through the compound, she confronted Dasem directly as he wielded the Scorpio Key. By the time S.H.I.E.L.D. breached the palace, Elektra had already defeated him and taken possession of the artifact, denying both S.H.I.E.L.D. and Hydra access to its power..

sadie bass.name: Sadie Bass
sadie bass.origin: Sadie Bass was an old lady who was attacked by four hoodlums in Central Park but was saved by the intervention of Spider-Man and the Gargoyle. Gargoyle immediately after the attempted assault offered to drive Sadie to her house, which she accepted. Arrived at home, Sadie asked Isaac to come in for a cup of tea, and there they talked until Sadie's daughter, Beatrice, arrived, who at the sight of the Gargoyle yelled at her mother to get away that he was a monster but Sadie calmed her down introducing Isaac to her and telling her he was a friend of hers. Beatrice scolded her mother for letting a stranger into her house and told her they were late for their appointment with Dr. Bernbaum but Sadie told her she wasn't going to any doctor. The quarrel between the two women was stopped by Gargoyle who took them both on a flight around the city, pointing out how it teemed with life and how many aspects it was formed. Upon returning home Sadie said goodbye saying that she was tired and that she needed to sleep and then die in her bed with her daughter and Gargoyle by her side.

sadie deever.name: Sadie Deever
sadie deever.origin: Agent Deever was assigned to investigate the appearance of an enhanced individual at AvengersCon. After a Stark Industries Drones following Kamran blew up the Circle Q, Agent Deever ramped up her search and began using more aggressive counter measures to capture their targets. She continued to escalate despite her superior, Agent Cleary, giving her direct orders to stand down. After publicly losing to Ms. Marvel and putting civilian lives in danger, Agent Cleary fired her.
