sally sanders.name: Sally Sanders
sally sanders.origin: Millie's brother Mike is in town, just before he starts university. He introduces Millie and Clicker to his girlfriend Sally Sanders, who is studying acting. However Sally seems downcast and her lessons seem rather odd and there is no trace of her teacher, Farley Fogg, in the acting community. Millie gives Sally some free tips on poise, charm, make-up and hair-styling, and asks about Fogg's teaching, which doesn't seem to cover actual acting techniques. Millie and her fellow models decide to investigate. As Jill's photos have not yet been published she goes to Fogg's office, posing as an aspirant actor but she records their interview. When the tape is played back to Sally she realizes that Fogg is a phoney who says identical things to all applicants. Fogg arrives at Sally's apartment to check on progress only to find she has compared notes with Jill. The girls realise Fogg is sincere about the women's talent and believes he can develop it but lacks the ability. Sally agrees to attend Mike's university which has a great drama department. Millie, Clicker, Mike and Sally go and celebrate at the Super Soda discotheque.

sally sherman.name: Sally Sherman
sally sherman.origin: Sally Sherman was a student at John Hathorne High School in Salem, Massachusetts, a town split between magic-using families referred to as "Wicks" and those without magical abilities, called "Blanks". Sherman was a "Wick" with thermokinetic powers. When Sherman broke up with her boyfriend, fellow student and presumed "Blank" Chad Barrow, it was revealed that Barrow as actually the Thief, a magical parasitic mutation with the ability to steal and manipulate other's magic. Barrow lost control and killed Sherman by using her own power to freeze her to death. Distraught, Barrow set out to gather the power to resurrect Sherman. Sherman's ghost, uninterested in returning to life if it meant being back with the man who killed her, set out to guide Kim Vesco, a young necromancer new to both Salem and her powers and prophesied to defeat the Thief. Barrow destroyed the Pillar of Smoke, a powerful source of magic, and consumed part of the Pillar. This gave Barrow the power to take control of almost all the wicks in Salem and resurrect Sherman under his control. Vesco, leading a small group of other teenage wicks, distracted the Barrow long enough for Vesco to free Sherman from Barrow's control. Sherman, ready to move on, bid Vesco farewell and dragged Barrow with her into the afterlife.

salo.name: Salo
salo.origin: Salo was in command of a massive Annihilation Wave warship called the Harvester of Sorrow that had the ability to destroy planets. After he used it to destroy a planet belonging to the Skrull Empire, Super-Skrull and his army decided to destroy it. He built a virus and brought it aboard the ship to destroy it. However, Salo captured them and destroyed Kl'rt's homeworld, killing his son. Super-Skrull and his soldier broke out and he killed Salo before destroying the ship.

salome khauran.name: Salome (Khauran)
salome khauran.origin: Salome was born a princess of Khauran, the twin daughter of Taramis. She was possibly the descendant of the millennia-old sorceresses of the same name. Salome was left to die in the desert because she bore the mark of the witch. Salome was was found and raised by a magician from Khitai. Years later, she returned to her home of Khauran and tried to usurp her sister Taramis' throne, but was defeated by an uprising led by Conan, former Captain of the guards.

salt warpies.origin: Very little is known about the Warpie known as Salt, except that he gained his powers through an after effect of a reality warp created by Mad Jim Jaspers when he attempted to take over Great Britain. Later he became a government agent working for the R.C.X. at their Cloud Nine facility as a member of the Advocates team of elite fighters that were assigned as the personal protection detail for Agent Peter. It is unknown if Salt was on Otherworld along with the other Warpies when Captain Britain took their powers away or not.

salty gruner.name: Salty Gruner
salty gruner.origin: ===Origins=== Salty Gruner was among a group of convicts sent to Lost Island Prison. Upon arrival, Salty and the others noticed that there was minimal security in the prison building itself. They discovered that this was because there was believed to be no point for anyone to attempt to escape, the surrounding waters of the island were shark infested and the jungle was said to be home to a mythical Ape Man creature. Gruner decided to use local superstition of the Ape Man to help facilitate his own escape and ran into the jungle under the cover of nightfall, believing that no one would follow him for fear of running into the monster. Once in the jungle, however, Gruner realized that the legends were true as he came face to face with the giant ape himself. The ape related the story of his affliction to Gruner. Apparently years ago he had been a normal man who upset a local witch doctor. In retribution, the witch doctor cursed the man, transforming him into a large giant ape creature. The only way that the curse could be lifted was for him to transfer it to another person, an incredibly hard task in the uninhabited jungles of the Lost Island. His long lasting curse, however, finally came to an end when he found Salty. The convict fainted from fear, only to recover some time later thinking that he had dreamed the entire encounter. He soon discovered, however, that the curse had been transferred to him, and he was now destined to live in the jungle until he could find someone else to pass the curse to. ===Modern Age=== Decades later, the Ape Man somehow managed to escape the island and ended up on Monster Isle. During an absence by Mole Man, Ape Man was one of four giant monsters were frightened off in the underground caverns by the monster Chtylok when it entered Mole Man's throne room. Years later, he would attempt to seek refuge in Monster Metropolis. However, when the Hunter of Monster Special Force raided the city, Salty was one of the casualties as he was killed by the samurai soldiers in front of Michael Morbius.

salty smith.name: Salty Smith
salty smith.origin: Seaman 1st Class "Salty" Smith was in the United States Navy during the Korean War. He frequently got into altercations with soldiers in the People's Liberation Army of China along with his best friend, Petty Officer "Battleship" Burk. Their earliest recorded appearance occurred in October of 1950, where the pair diverted an enemy seamine field that was along the course an infantry ship that was due through the area. On December 10, 1950 occurred during downtime while Battleship and Salty were among the soldiers in Admiral Doyle's navy amphibious fleet that were waiting in Hangnam Harbor to proceed on a mission to rescue 1st Division marines retreating from the Changjin Reservoir. Battleship and Salty went to shore where they clashed with Chinese forces under the command of Hangnam Hannah who had set up a massive artillery cannon on skis to allow it to freely move and attack their fleet. Battleship and Salty managed to steal the cannon and dump it in the ocean, allowing Naval forces to destroy Chinese forces in the area and rescue the troops. On December 15th of that year, the pair assisted Navy and GI forces land on the heavily fortified Inchon Harbor. Later that month, Battleship and Smith were sent to capture an enemy ship and found themselves captured by the Chinese instead. However they broke out of their cell with the help of South Korean freedom fighter Hoon Sik-Soon, who later sacrificed his life to stop the Chinese from destroying the nearby American battleship. Given 12 hour leave in Seoul, Battleship and Salty were captured by Red Mary and taken aboard her flee of junk ships armed with guns. She tried to force the pair to pilot their fleet through Naval sea mines, instead Burke led them to the destroyer he was stationed on and the pair abandoned ship as Red Mary's fleet was blasted out of the water. Later, Battleship and Salty were captured by a Chinese sub while returning from shore leave in Seoul. They were then forced to load torpedos to attack their own ships, but instead sabotaged the torpedoes to boomerang back at the sub and escape. Not long after, while on another shore leave, they were charged with returning a "secret package" back to their ship. En route, they were captured by the forces of T'ao Kuk and brought to his hidden base. Having stashed the "secret package", Battleship and Salty broke free and sabotaged Kuk's base and escape with their package. Upon returning to their ship they were shocked to learn the "secret" they were protecting was nothing more than a box of ice cream, which had melted during their daring escape. In August of 1952, Battleship and Salty were on shore leave so that Burke could deliver a present to his brother Shannon from their mother. Shannon was a member of the US Army and upon learning that Shannon and his commanding officer were captured by the enemy. Burke and Smith used their know how to help Shannon's unit rescue the prisoners and destroy a communist dam. In June of the following year, Battleship and Salty were tricked into going to the mainland where reports of Navy men being captured by enemy soldiers were being reported. However they were betrayed by the woman who led them there and taken prisoners themselves. However the woman soon rescued the pair, revealing that she worked with the communists because they had her son prisoner. Learning that enemy soldiers were going to try and infiltrate their command ship by wearing their stolen uniforms, Battleship and Salty rushed to the nearby peer just in time to see the ship sink as Salty had the forethought to remove the bailing plug from the ship before they were captured. Battleship and Salty were later sent to pick up the admiral's daughter from the Seoul airport. However the trio were captured by enemy troops and Salty was released to ransom off Battleship and the admiral's daughter in the hopes of leading the battleship into a trap. However Burke and the admiral's daughter managed to break free and signal the ship warning it of the trap. Later the pair were ordered to recover a sunken enemy ship which contained information on the enemy that could turn the tide of the war. The duo fought sharks, an octopus and enemy skin-divers in order to recover the plans, a major victory for the United Nations during the Korean War. Later the pair struck another major blow to the Chinese army when they posed as communist soldiers and single handedly destroyed the enemy base in Chunchow. Shortly thereafter the pair found themselves diving into the ocean once more, this time under orders to recover an enemy plane that they shot down. While on this operation Burke and Salty managed to incapacitate a mini-sub. Later while on three day shore leave, Burke and Salty accepted a challenge from two US Army soldiers to fight with them on the front line, and assisted in destroying an enemy ammo dump in a flooded rice paddy. The pair later prevented an attempt by captured communist soldiers from taking over their ship. In their

salvatore carbone.name: Salvatore Carbone
salvatore carbone.origin: Salvatore Carbone was the second-in-command of Carbone Family, led by his brother Julius. When The Punisher, who was in process of infiltrating the organization as "Johnny Tower", produced evidence of his deals with Koreans, Julius ordered his death. Said deed was tasked to the Punisher and Mickey Fondozzi, but Sal proved to be a resistant sort and managed to escape them. However, his run was cut short by when he fell through ice into a frozen river. Thinking the cold would be enough to do him in, his two would-be executioners left. Sal managed to survive the ordeal, but with the loss of his memory. Remembering nothing but the faces of the men who tried to have him killed, he took the new name "Thorn" from a passing road sign as he started his quest for revenge. He proved himself to be a dangerous opponent after his "death", as he felt no pain or exhaustion, and managed to shrug various mortal wounds inflicted upon him. After his last encounter with Punisher, he was accidentally transported to Newark, New Jersey, where presumably he still resides.

salvo neo.name: Salvo (Neo)
salvo neo.origin: Salvo was a member of the Warclan, one of the different communities of the Neo, who comprised different clans of recluse mutants. The Neo suffered a major crisis after the High Evolutionary temporarily deactivated the mutant gene. As a result, they unleashed their rage upon Earth and, more specifically, the X-Men, a group of mutant activists who promoted racial integration. The Warclan brutally attacked the X-Men. As a loyal member of his clan, Salvo was part of the strike force led by the Jaeger Rax who struck against some X-Men. Following the eradication of the Legacy Virus, Magneto, the master of magnetism and ruler of Genosha, appeared before chieftain Domina demanding subservience from the Warclan. Salvo joined the Jaeger in an attempt to kill Magneto to gain respect, but was swiftly executed. Claiming he would tolerate mutants fighting each other no more, Magneto forced Domina to surrender her clan and to join him.

sam blockbuster.name: Sam Blockbuster
sam blockbuster.first_appearance: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends Season 1 9
sam blockbuster.origin: Sam Blockbuster was one of the most succesful movie directors in the Hollywood of Earth-8107. After many famous movies, Blockbuster decided to make a film about Spider-Man, and he invested all his money on it. However, the production seemed to be ill-fated, accidents were frequent during the filming and the director suffered the resignation of at least five actors. After one of this events, Sam Blockbuster was kidnapped while driving home, and there he met the villian Mysterio, who revealed he was behind all the apparent bad luck in his film. Mysterio told Blockbuster he wanted him to hire the real Spider-Man, so that he could murder him in the set. Menaced with the possibility of also being murdered, and thinking the movie could still make a lot of money, Blockbuster accepted to help Mysterio, and he hired Spider-Man for his film, making him appear in four scenes where Mysterio created mortal traps. Under instruction of Mysterio, Blockbuster also helped to get ride of Iceman and Firestar, who helped save Spider-Man's life in various traps. Unknown to everyone, Blockbuster also hired Bruce Banner as part of his crew. Banner went unnoticed by the rest of the workers, but he noticed something fishy behind the producer, and eventually, transforming into the Hulk, he also saved Spider-Man's life. With Mysterio revealed as the villian and Sam Blockbuster's part in his plot known, Sam was trapped by Spider-Man, and he was arrested by Los Angeles police department. Blockbuster accepted his blame, but saw his arrest as an opportunity, because he always had wanted to make a prison film.

sam buckley.name: Sam Buckley
sam buckley.origin: thumb|left|200pxSam Buckley was an agent of the Federal Bureau of Investigation who independently pursued the serial vigilante Gregory Salinger, known as the Foolkiller. Rather than being officially assigned to the case, Buckley initiated the investigation on his own time, convincing fellow agent Lou Caldwell—albeit with difficulty—to assist him. Their goal was to solve a high-profile case that had eluded the Bureau and advance their careers. Following a series of murders targeting individuals deemed “fools,” the investigation took a personal turn when both agents received a letter from Salinger labeling them as such. While searching an alley in the Bowery, Buckley and his partner were ambushed by the Foolkiller, who used his laser weapon to incinerate them. After killing the agents, Salinger destroyed the files they had compiled, preventing others from continuing the investigation from their work.

sam bullit.name: Sam Bullit
sam bullit.origin: Sam Bullit was a candidate for the office of New York's District Attorney. After George Stacy was killed in a battle between Spider-Man and Doctor Octopus, he enlisted the help of Stacy's daughter Gwen and Daily Bugle publisher J.J. Jameson for his law and order campaign, vowing to bring Spider-Man to justice. Jameson initially supported Bullit. However, after Bullit's men roughed up Peter Parker and Bullit's shady dealings with radical groups were uncovered by Joe Robertson, Jameson took back his endorsement. Bullit then kidnapped Joe who was later rescued by Spider-Man and Iceman. Afterward, Joe, Spider-Man, and Iceman confronted Bullit at a fund raiser he organized. With the truth revealed, the banquet attendees walked out, and Bullit was arrested.

sam colby.name: Sam Colby
sam colby.origin: Riding into town, the Two-Gun Kid comes to the aid of Charlie "Bobo" Colby, a mentally challenged boy who is being bullied by the locals. The Kid feels pity for Bobo who is the butt of everyone's jokes and doesn't seem to be bright enough to realize that they are making fun of him instead of laughing with him. The Kid offers to ride him home and he eventually ends up at the Colby ranch. He meets with Bobo's father, who called for the Kid to meet with him. Sam explains that the taunts of the locals have made Sam decide to move to a new ranch, hence why he asked the Kid to find them a new home. Their discussion is interrupted when the Kid hears Bobo shooting off his gun. Going out to see he is shocked to find that the mentally challenged youngster is actually a crack shot. The Kid learns that Bobo has been learning how to shoot for years and idolizes outlaws like Trigger Ratel and Scar Trevis. When Two-Gun and Sam ride into town to get supplies, the Kid tells Sam that he needs to talk to him after they get back. When the trio arrive in town they are there to witness the arrival of Scar Trevis. When Scar begins bullying those in town, Bobo draws his gun and shoots Scar's out of his hand. Shocked at Bobo's shooting skills the local instantly befriend him and bring him into the local saloon to buy him a beer. In enters Trigger Ratel enters the saloon demanding to draw against the man who out shot Scar. Bobo still shoots the gun out of Trigger's hand as well. Bobo's sudden realization that those fear him and all the years of being torment catch up with him and he decides that he is going to take over the entire town. Seeing what is happening, the Two-Gun Kid decides to put a stop to things and confronts Bobo telling him that Scar and Trigger were another in a series of jokes and outshoots Bobo, destroying his gun. Realizing he hates guns now, the simple minded Bobo decides to abandon his ambitions and soon he and Sam are packed up and heading off to their new home. Sam thanks the Two-Gun Kid for his help.

Indeed, the New York game had not been canceled but a hero had invented everything to take his place and infiltrate Hammerhead's organization.

sam farrow.origin: Sam was a con man who just released from the jail moved to a small Balkan state where he accepted the bus-driver work for a hotel and from there scam the hotel's customers. Entering the bus on a road where the Hotel Manager earlier told him not to go, and convinced that he would find there even easier victims to cheat on, he suddenly found himself surrounded by a dense fog where inside it appeared strange figures lurking in it that greatly frightened Sam to such a degree that once he managed to escape from the fog-infested place he redeems himself to accept a laborious but honest job on board a ship.

sam felix.name: Sam Felix
sam felix.origin: Sam Felix was a resident of the Underground City in San Francisco who began carrying out a racket against a group of above-ground squatters. When the squatters fought back by hiring the cyborg mercenary Mace to protect them, Felix lied to Venom - the Underground City's Lethal Protector - hoping to trick him into killing them. However, lawyer Beck Underwood figured out what was going on and told Venom, who - despite promising Beck to not use lethal force - confronted Felix and his gang and killed them.

sam garr.name: Sam Garr
sam garr.origin: Sam Garr was manipulated by bank robbers to participate in their crime unknowingly. He was arrested and sentenced to ten years. His baby Billy was born two months later; and when he heard his wife was dying, he escaped. Now a fugitive with a price on his head, he took his son and settled on a ranch at the edge of the desert, a very difficult place to live. sam kirby.name: Sam Kirby
sam kirby.origin: Sam Kirby was a detective for the Police "Missing Persons" bureau. He was assigned to investigate the continuous disappearances of people who disappeared for no apparent reason in the East Side. The only clue that these people had in common was that before their disappearance they had met a Fat Man. Having identified the person, Sam met him in a pub and started a conversation with him, then the Fat Man, who called himself Charles Call, invited him to his house to continue the conversation and at the same time used his powers to mentally control him. Sam pretended to give in to his powers and followed him home and there the Fat Man revealed that he came from another world that was depopulating and thanks to a temporal tear he had ended up on our Earth and thanks to his powers he controlled people and took them to his planet to repopulate it. Sam at this point tried to arrest him but the Fat Man turned out to be more powerful than he seemed and it was he who subdued Sam and took him to his world. Once in the alien world, however, Sam recovered and managed to bring the other kidnapped people back from their hypnotic stupor, who rebelled against the Fat Man, subduing him and returning to Earth, destroying the building where the time rift was. Once back on Earth, all the people who had been kidnapped suffered mass amnesia, all except Sam, who remembered everything but realized that no one would believe him.

sam marvin.name: Sam Marvin
sam marvin.origin: Sam Marvin purchased the mortgage on Pete Williams' ranch the Bar W, giving him sixty days to find the money to buy it back. On the 55th day of their contract, Williams came up with the money and attempted to buy back his ranch. Marvin, who was using it as a means of smuggling stolen cattle into Mexico through the Rio Grande refused to do so, leading to an altercation. Broken up by the disguised Masked Raider, Marvin left the scene and charged Williams with trumped up assault charges so that he would be locked up for the remainder of the contract time. The Masked Raider escaped arrest and investigated Marvin, learning of his cattle rustling operation. When Marvin moved his next herd of stolen beef across the Rio Grande, the Raider came to stop him. As the Raider rounded up Sam's men, Marvin attempted to shoot the Raider in the back. He would not get the chance, however, as he was attacked by the Raider's faithful horse Lightning. Marvin was rounded up with the rest of his men and turned over to the sheriff and lost his ill gotten land to Williams.

sam matonabbe.name: Sam Matonabbe
sam matonabbe.origin: Sam Matonabbe was a half-Caucasian/half-Chipewyan Indian living in the Northwest Territories of Canada. Despite his great stature and physical prowess, Matonabbe had always been ridiculed by the townsfolk for his "half-breed" status. Somehow, Matonabbe came to the attention of Pixie, a member of the race of Eternals who was looking for adventure among normal humans. Pixie was looking for a person who would become her crime-fighting partner, and she chose Matonabbe after watching how he dealt with those who would ridicule him. Determined to make him her partner, Pixie convinced him to use his powers as a crime fighter. Together, the two became known as Pixie and Oxbow, and they were later asked to join the premier superhero team of their generation, the First Line. Over time, the two developed a romantic relationship and were rarely seen apart. Pixie and Oxbow were among the members of the First Line assembled for its final mission, defeating an invasion by the alien Skrulls. Matonabbe was killed during the battle.

sam ross.origin: Sam Ross worked for Northstar Airways under Madelyne Pryor as a loadmaster. He has a passion for reading, and to an extent, writing, often using the many hours of flying to read. When a plane he was working (and Madelyne was flying) was brought down by the birth of the FireFountain, he was reborn into Lore Lord, a living embodiment of the written tome. However, it was revealed the entire situation was a set-up by Loki, who sent his Snow Giants against the people who had been transformed (as well as the X-Men and Alpha Flight) after they had revoked him. One of them swung a club at Maddie and he dove to push her out of the way and was struck himself. He was sent flying, hurtling miles away. Anodyne and Northstar chased after him only to find him near death. To save his life, Anodyne willingly gave herself over to Loki to restore her healing powers.

sam scorpio.name: Sam Scorpio
sam scorpio.origin: Scorpio was once the terror of the southwestern states, employing what he called "the Scorpion's Sting" to spread fear among other gunmen. It appeared that the Scorpion seemed able to simply gesture at a target and strike it with an unseen force. Against another man, the Scorpion could best any gunslinger with a mere gesture that was as effective as a bullet. In truth, the Scorpion had been firing his gun all along. Scorpio hid a silent Derringer under the sleeve of his right arm, with a sting tied from the trigger to his finger. With no noise escaping the gun's chamber, Scorpio seemed capable of truly supernatural feats. He attempted to form a partnership with Kid Colt as he was setting up a new gang, but Colt refused to work with him. Instead, Colt exposed his trick to the public and turned him and his gang over to the authorities. Scorpio was sent to state prison and placed on a chain gang where he allied himself with the criminal ventriloquist Dr. Danger and former gang leader Bull Barton. The three men managed to overpower a guard while on work duty and used the guard's gun to shoot off their chains. They escaped across the border, but Kid Colt tracked them down and returned them to the law.

sam silvercloud.name: Sam Silvercloud
sam silvercloud.origin: Sam Silvercloud was a member of an Apache tribe. When Johnny Blaze planned to jump Copperhead Canyon, this plan angered several members of the tribe, who feared that the publicity of the stunt would make the land too valuable to ever allow the Apache to purchase for their own. Sam Silvercloud picked Blaze up in alleged preparation for the stunt, but then left him in the desert, when he refused to cancel the jump. Blaze made it back and fought Silvercloud, but was then confronted by Snake Dance who broke up the fight and warned Blaze to stay away from the Canyon. Silvercloud sabotaged Blaze's cycle, and Snake Dance and his "Serpent-Men" ambushed him as he traveled back to town that evening, as the Ghost Rider. Ghost Rider fled, and tried to use his cycle to escape by jumping the Canyon. However, as a result of Silvercloud's sabotage, the engine blew up in mid-leap and Ghost Rider fell towards certain death. Thinking Blaze to be dead and wishing to cover up loose ends, Silvercloud kidnapped Blaze's girlfriend, Roxanne Simpson, and brought her to Snake Dance. Ghost Rider then arrived, easily overpowered Snake Dance and his allies, set their ritual site on fire, and took Roxanne to get help.

sam striker.name: Sam Striker
sam striker.origin: Sam Striker was the owner of the Camelot Hotel and Casino and the Excalibur Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada. He was a businessman rival to Michael Berengetti, owner of the Coliseum Casino, and one of his worst enemies. Although Striker was a criminal and wanted to be the The most powerful man in Las Vegas, did not dare take action directly against Berengetti as long as Berengetti had adequate protection, which included the super-powered enforcer Mr. Fixit; Striker did not know Fixit's name, but he knew that Berengetti was well protected. After Fixit stopped working for Berengetti, Striker hired the superpowered freelance hitman Frost as his main enforcer in the city, yet Striker had many other men at his command. Striker sent Frost to assassinate Berengetti on his orders. The widow, Suzi Berengetti, inherited the Coliseum and other businesses from her husband, but Striker hoped to intimidate her into giving him everything. During her funeral, Striker convinced several Coliseum employees that he was going to be the city's next top man, so that they would let him into Berengetti's private offices, possibly to conduct industrial espionage. His presence there surprised Mrs. Berengetti when she returned with her friend Mona. Striker asked Mrs. Berengetti to hand over her husband's private files and bank accounts, saying that Michael Berengetti would have wanted Striker to keep them. Mrs. Berengetti, who knew Striker, told him to go to hell and insulted him, but Striker saw that she had no one who could protect her and mocked her. Then Berengetti's former protector, Mr. Fixit, arrived, accompanied by his own entourage of thugs, claiming that Fixit, not Striker, was the top man in Las Vegas. Striker sent his goons after Fixit, but Fixit easily got rid of them. He was not so lucky with Frost, whose superhuman strength was comparable to Fixit's, but Fixit intimidated Striker, convincing him to back down. Striker, choosing his battles, decided to retreat and suggested that he had been only offering her help to her widow but, if she didn't want it, he would leave. Fixit's sudden arrival brought attention that Striker wanted for himself, and Striker decided to get rid of Fixit before continuing his plans. At the same time, one of Fixit's men, Paris, who had empathic powers, said he had sensed such happiness and self-satisfaction in Striker during their encounter, that he was convinced that Striker had murdered Berengetti; and Fixit had gone to Las Vegas to solve the murder of his friend Berengetti. During his investigation, Fixit allied himself with the vigilante Punisher, who was hot on Frost's trail, and with detective Louisa Sanchez, of LVPD, to lure out Striker and Frost with a fake drug buy. As part of that plan, Paris visited Striker in the Excalibur, falsely saying that he wanted to join Striker's people because he expected Striker would defeat Fixit. To convince Striker, he told him that Fixit was going to receive a shipment of illegal drugs (provided by Punisher) at the Acme Storage warehouse over on 5th, at 10:00 p.m., and that Fixit was going to be there, so Striker could notify the police and have Fixit arrested. Paris had to go to the operation, so that Fixit wouldn't get suspicious, but Paris was counting on Striker to use his influence after him to get him out of jail. However, Striker decided that, instead, he would have his people attack the operation to kill Fixit, and keep the drugs and money. In reality, the drugs were just cremora, the provider "Frank Tower" was the Punisher in disguise, and several LVPD agents would be hiding in the warehouse, waiting for Striker to confess to Berengetti's murder. That night, Striker had Frost take compromising photos of Fixit with the drugs, revealed his presence, and demanded the drugs and money, or he would turn the photos over to the police. Fixit pretended to be on the ropes, and Striker began talking about how he could Fixit as he had killed Berengetti; Fixit convinced him to give details by accusing him of being too cowardly to kill him in person, and Striker admitted Frost had done the deed, identifying the gun; when the police had enough information, they revealed themselves. Frost initiated a shootout against the police, during which Striker was wounded in the right leg, just over the knee, but Fixit and his allies had superpowers that protected the police officers. Fixit and Frost continued their fight outside the warehouse, causing damage to Striker's Camelot Hotel. When the shooting ended, Paris kicked Striker's bleeding leg, after which Striker was arrested; Frost was presumed dead.

sam thorne.name: Sam Thorne
sam thorne.origin: Sam Thorne was an old classmate of Reed Richards and Victor von Doom --later Mister Fantastic of the Fantastic Four and the Latverian dictator Doctor Doom -- during their years at State University. After graduating, Thorne ended up becoming coach for the Metro College football team, he also married a woman named Belle and earned himself quite a reputation, often being compared to Notre Dame coach Knute Rockne. During the modern age of heroes, Sam coached over a team that included Whitey Mullins. He later discovered Wyatt Wingfoot who was friends with the Fantastic Four's Human Torch, while the youthful super-hero attended Metro. Thorne tried to convince Wingfoot to play for the team. While he failed at coaxing the Native American student from joining the team, his wife Belle managed to convince Wyatt to join up. Shortly thereafter Throne was a witness as one of his football games was interrupted by the arrival of Crystal and her pet Lockjaw while she was searching for her boyfriend, the Human Torch. Years later he was on hand when Wyatt eventually graduated. This was during a period of in which the Fantastic Four's Mister Fantastic and his wife the Invisible Girl were separate and he offered his condolences. Both Sam and Reed were later invited to a class reunion together. This proved to be a petty trap set by Doctor Doom seeking to get revenge against both Richards and Thorne for his grievances against them dating back to their university years. Both were rescued by the remaining members of the Fantastic Four.

sam yurimoto.origin: Thermite was empowered to become a member of the New Enforcers who battled Blood Rose and Spider-Man, and although he flash-froze and destroyed Spider-Man's armor, he was defeated by Spider-Man. He and the New Enforcers were hired by the Life Foundation and Alchemax to recover the Venom symbiote from Dylan Brock. When Dylan sought refuge in Moon Knight's Midnight Mission, the New Enforcers broke in, and were taken down by the two working together. Thermite was taken down by accidental friendly fire from the Eel.

fields.trivia: is a character from Jewish mythology, depicted as an archangel and as the "archangel of death". His name is theophoric and references the patron deity "El". The name variously translates to English as the "Venom of God,", the "Poison of God," and the "Blindness of God". He was the guardian angel of Esau (son of the patriarch Isaac, older brother the patriarch Jacob) and a patron of the kingdom of Edom. His role varies in Jewish texts over the centuries, and he has been depicted as both good and evil. He is at times identified with Satan. In Gnostic texts from antiquity, "Samael" was used as one of the names for the "Demiurge" ("Creator" or "Artisan" in the Greek language). The Gnostics believed that the material world was created by a flawed or evil deity (the Demiurge), while the spiritual world was created by a benevolent deity (the Aeon). In Christian demonology, Samael is often identified with the fallen angel Azazel.

samain.name: Samain
samain.origin: Samain was one of the Cimmerian royal guardsmen of King Bafomai's Elite Guard. As a time-displaced Conan snuck into the royal palace to assassinate Bafomai, he knocked unconscious Beltan and Samain. Despite the rebel leader Mahalat's demands, Conan refused to slay them, and instead bound them. Nevertheless, Mahalat slit their throats as soon as Conan was away.

samantha dunbar heroes reborn.name: Samantha Dunbar (Heroes Reborn)
samantha dunbar heroes reborn.origin: When the Fantastic Four and the Avengers sacrificed their lives to destroy Onslaught, Franklin Richards, the son of the FF's Mr. Fantastic and Invisible Woman subconsciously created a pocket universe to save their lives. There they spent an entire year reliving living new lives "reborn" into a reality where they recently gained their abilities that vaguely mirror how they gained their powers originally. This new universe was completely populated with beings unique to his creation, one of them included Samantha Dunbar. Samantha lived with her husband in New York City, and she and her family were out sailing the day that the worlds heroes native to Earth-616 left Counter-Earth to return home in order to save both Earth's from destruction at the hands of the Celestials. Just after the world was thrown into complete chaos by the Dreaming Celestial, causing a giant tidal wave that flooded most of the eastern United States. Samantha's family drowned, however she survived and began living in a post penthouse apartment, scavenging for her needs and avoiding the patrols by both SHIELD and the Atlan armies. One day, Dr. Doom fell from the sky in a blaze of fire and crashed into the water near her dwelling. Not knowing who the man was, Samantha would go to his rescue, helping Doom fend off attacking Atlan soldiers. They would escape to the Baxter Building where Doom would use CPR to revive her. Realizing who it was she saved, Samantha lashed out before collapsing in an emotional heap. She would tell Doom what had happened to their world, prompting Doom to decide to try and save Counter-Earth and rule over it. As Samantha would rest, Doom would monitor the planet and come up with a solution to the problem. However when the Baxter Building is invaded by SHIELD and Atlan agents possessed by some strange mailable parasite, Doom would empower Samantha to fire powerful microwave energy. As Lancer she would destroy the creature and it's host bodies saving Doom's life. She would agree to become Doom's ally in his quest to tame a mad world. Lancer would later clash with the creature known as Divinity as it was attacking Ashema a Celestial trapped in human form for aiding the heroes in returning to Earth-616. The battle would end with Lancer defeating Divinity, however Ashema would escape. After this conflict Samantha would learn that Doom had installed nanites into her body to monitor her at all times, a move that angered the woman, but she none the less remained loyal to Doom. They would next travel to Atlan where they would gain an alliance with Dorma ruler of Atlantis. Traveling to the North West, Lancer would battle Tomazooma while Doom would free Ashema and induct her and Divinity to his cause. Much later, Doom would recruit Shakti and Technarx to his cause and they would prevent Wakanda from being invaded by the Arabian Knights. With Wakanda annexed into Doom's empire, Lancer was charged with making it's ousted prince of Wakanda after he failed to assassinate Doom. Dorma, manipulated by the Dreaming Celestial would lead Shakti, Divinity and Technarx in an attempted coup of Doom's reign, by first attacking Lancer. Lancer would prove to be immune to Shakti's magics, and Technarx's transmode virus, easily defeating them. The coup would be ended when Ashema (regaining her powers) would use them to battle the Dreaming Celestial and transport Counter-Earth to the Earth-616 universe where it could be less easily manipulated. However, this would not stop the Dreaming Celestial from continuing to attack Counter-Earth, prompting Doom and his generals to go to Earth-616. There Lancer would meet Marvel Girl of Earth-99315, and clash with the Fantastic Four. She would chastise the Fantastic Four for abandoning Counter-Earth and praised Doom for being the only one attempting to bring order to her troubled world. The Fantastic Four would then agree to accompany Doom and his generals back to Counter-Earth in order to save it from the Celestials. The resulting battle ended in the seeming destruction of Mr. Fantastic, however he was in reality became trapped in Doom's armor while Doom was banished. Lancer would learn the truth, and agree to allow the ruse to continue in order to keep Doom's generals in line, and also considered Richards posing as Doom being better for Counter-Earth than having Doom himself in control. Ultimately, Dorma and the other Generals would turn against Doom and attempt to destroy the Earth, however they would be stopped by the Avengers and "Doom" would turn over his control of Counter-Earth to Lancer. Lancer would keep Counter-Earth under her control and awaited the return of the true Dr. Doom. There would be many that would claim to be Doom, all of which would be slain as impostors. samantha eden.name: Samantha Eden
samantha eden.origin: While living in Marseille and posing as a member of the jet set, Samantha was introduced to the actor Brad Carter. She had a brief romantic relationship with Carter. Afterwards, she still considered Carter to be her close friend and a surrogate brother. Working as a journalist, Samantha wrote articles on the disappearances of several prominent scientists. At the time, she was unaware that all these disappearances were orchestrated by Centurius. Having heard of Ulysses Bloodstone, Samantha decided that the man was newsworthy. She decided to meet him in person. Easily tracking him down in Brazil, she learned about his upcoming voyage by passenger ship. She boarded the same ship in Rio de Janeiro. Noticing suspicious-looking men on deck, she photographed them. She entered Bloodstone's stateroom to alert him about imminent danger, but Bloodstone had already been attacked by the strangers. Samantha risked her own safety to photograph Goram's attack on the ship. Bloodstone decided that he could use her help in a mission, so he invited her to join him to "The Island". Bloodstone, Samantha, and Brad Carter used a submarine to travel to Bloodstone Island. She photographed a battle between Bloodstone and Goram, though she suspected that it may be a mere publicity stunt. After a few incidents on the island, Bloodstone explained his immortality to Samantha. He gave her access to his files, allowing her to write about him. She soon realized that Bloodstone had kept copies of her articles on disappearances in his files, and that he was familiar with her work. She suspected that was why Bloodstone chose her as a new traveling companion. Bloodstone was more interested in using her press connections to find out details about the disappearances which were never released to the public. Samantha arranged for Bloodstone to have a personal meeting with one of her close friends, who could hopefully provide assistance. The friend in question was the businessman Tony Stark. Left alone in Bloodstone Island for a while, Samantha learned how to operate the defense controls. The defense system was still operating when Ulysses returned, and he found himself attacked by his own system. Bloodstone wanted her to leave the island, but he had a job offer for her. He wanted Samantha to work as both a researcher for his investigations, and as his representative for public relations. She was hesitant to take the job, so Bloodstone gave her a deadline of two days to decide whether to accept or not. Samantha returned to her home in Marseille, but she found Domino waiting for her inside the house. He took her hostage at gunpoint. Domino and Samantha had a meal together at a cafe in Marseille. Samantha asked the other patrons of the cafe to help her, but Domino assured them that she was joking. The patrons believed him, and nobody attempted to help Samantha. Domino told her not to bother with escape attempts, as he could easily locate and recapture her. Samantha visited Bloodstone at his hotel in New York City, and then joined him in visiting a seedy bar in Harlem. Bloodstone had acquired one of the Conspiracy's programming tapes and he wanted one of his agents in the bar to decipher it. To Bloodstone's disappointment, the message in the tape seemed meaningless. It combined an apparent cabalistic reference with an astrological symbol. Ulysses tasked Samantha to find out whether the references had any actual meaning. He told her that by joining him in this mission, she had implicitly accepted a position as his new employee. Samantha studied various works in the New York Public Library, trying to decipher the message. She decided that it was probably a red herring, which was intended to confuse whoever acquired it. Domino visited Samantha at the library, and told her that Bloodstone was dead. Samantha coldly commented that her research assignment had no meaning. Domino was surprised at her callousness, but she informed him that she only viewed Bloodstone as potential story to print. She asked details about Bloodstone's death, but Domino refused to provide any explanation. She told him that she could easily find the hidden information through her journalistic sources. Domino admitted to Samantha that her abduction was only intended to distract her. The Conspiracy's plan for Bloodstone needed certain aspects of his personality to remain dormant, and they were worried that Samantha would manage to awaken them. Samantha admitted that Bloodstone viewed her as a potential lover, but she claimed that she was never actually interested in him. She mockingly eulogized Bloodstone as the biggest bore who ever walked on planet Earth.

She soon realized that Bloodstone had kept copies of her articles on disappearances in his files, and that he was familiar with her work. She suspected that was why Bloodstone chose her as a new traveling companion. Samantha admitted that Bloodstone viewed her as a potential lover, but she claimed that she was never actually interested in him. She mockingly eulogized Bloodstone as the biggest bore who ever walked on planet Earth.

fields.notes: All of her known appearances were only printed in black-and-white. Her eye color and hair color are uncertain, though the shading in the design of her hair indicates that she was a brunette. Samantha was apparently created as a love interest for Ulysses Bloodstone. There are several hints in their few stories that he was attracted to her, but Samantha was never particularly affectionate towards him. Her final appearance clarified that his attraction was one-sided and his love unrequited. In Marvel Legacy: The 1970s Handbook Vol 1 1, it was theorized that Samantha was hypnotized into feeling indifference towards Bloodstone's death. There is nothing to suggest that in the original story. Tony Stark asked Bloodstone about Samantha's health status , indicating that he had not met her in person for some time. Though he is mentioned only as her close friend, the implication may have been that he was one of Samantha's ex-boyfriends.

samantha mcgee.name: Samantha McGee
samantha mcgee.origin: Samantha McGee was a charter pilot, who was in hock up to her eyeballs, when she took a charter to fly Tony Stark up to Nunavut Territory in Canada to an archaeological dig. There they discovered the Temple of Balthakk, where inside, she stumbled across the Brazier of Balthakk, and touching it, she became Inferno, the Exemplar of Balthakk, a mystic entity that had entered into the Wager of the Octessence with seven other mystic entities. Together with the other Exemplars, they defeated the Avengers and the Juggernaut but in the end, Bedlam regaining her lost humanity used her mental powers to return the other Exemplars to their original mental state, free from their mystic benefactors influence/control. Panicking, they immediately left the Avengers. It is uncertain if they continue to retain their original mental state or if the mystic entities would again gain control of their avatars.

samantha parrington.name: Samantha Parrington
samantha parrington.origin: Born into a wealthy family of eccentric philanthropists, Samantha Parrington grew into an idealistic feminist. When her parents adopted the monstrous Hulk as their latest pet cause, Samantha formed a rapport with the misunderstood brute and helped talk him down from the Statue of Liberty, though her father took all the credit for this feat in the media. Miffed, Samantha led her women's group in an anti-patriarchal protest that attracted the attention of Hulk's enemy, Amora the Enchantress. Amora magically transformed Samantha into a raging, man-hating facsimile of the Asgardian warrior goddess Brunnhilde the Valkyrie, whose form and might Amora could replicate at will, having trapped Brunnhilde's soul in a mystical crystal centuries earlier. As the ersatz Valkyrie, Samantha battled the Hulk to a standstill until the spell wore off, returning her to normal just as Hulk reverted to his human form of Bruce Banner. The confused pair parted awkwardly, neither fully recalling their battle, with Samantha half-convinced it was all a dream. When the rogue god Pluto sought a Valkyrie pawn, he had Amora's sister Lorelei transform Samantha Parrington into the Valkyrie again. However, Pluto tricked Lorelei though, erasing her memory, draining her powers, and turning her into a duplicate of Valkyrie. While Samantha was used by Pluto to turn Earth into a realm of the dead, Lorelei was found by the Defender Nighthawk, who believed she was the real Valkyrie and made her a Defender, though she never spoke. Meanwhile a mind-controlled Samantha served Pluto and Lorelei until they ran afoul of the reunited Defenders and Brunnhilde, who routed Pluto and Lorelei, but only after Samantha battled Lorelei, she was restored to her former self and shook off their control. Happy to have a worthy successor on Earth, Brunnhilde returned to Asgard and Samantha joined the Defenders as their new Valkyrie. Her parents tried to support her new superheroic pursuits by offering the Defenders funding, equipment, and well-intentioned meddling. Brunnhilde, sadly, was among the many slain during an Asgardian revolt staged by Loki in fulfillment of the Ragnarok prophecies; but her proud heroic legacy lived on through Samantha Parrington. Brunnhilde has since seemingly returned following Thor's resurrection of the Asgardians; Samantha has apparently dropped out of sight.

samantha powell.name: Samantha Powell
samantha powell.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 15
samantha powell.origin: Samantha "Sam" Powell was a public relations specialist and the sister of mercenary Douglas Powell, who had joined Symkarian team Wild Pack. Some time later, Wild Pack managers Lorna Kleinfeldt and Morty hired Sam to take care of their PR. One of the main bases of the Pack was the Symkarian Embassy in New York City, and they took Sam to know the Pack members there. Sam did not hide the fact that she was related to Doug. She immediately found herself attracted to muscular, African-American Pack member Battlestar, which was an issue for Doug, as Doug was a racist and had often been at odds with Battlestar. The Wild Pack was hired to ensure that food supplies reached the intended destination of distressed civilians in war-ravaged Somalia, and Sam went with them there. In that relief operation, Wild Pack leader Silver Sable was interviewed by a journalist and, as he was offensive and almost slanderous, Sable reacted by beating him up; she then sent Sam to salvage the PR mess. Not long after that, Sam arranged for Sable to be interviewed in Phil Donahue's TV show. Sam remained literally behind the scenes in the set while Sable was interviewed. When the Pack was given a free night, Sam tried to convince Battlestar to go out with her, but Battlestar excused himself as he had already made plans with Somali teammate Lighbright - who, by the way, had attracted Doug's romantic interests. When Silver Sable was sent to jail, Sam joined the rest of the team in the Embassy, where Morty explained that Sable's lover Jacques Girard had given the CIA access to confidential information on the Wild Pack, and the CIA had added made-up charges against her. Sam complained that the public relations mess was beyond her skills to solve. Sable had ordered everybody to leave for Symkaria immediately, and Doug Powell and his teammate Crippler thought that this was a good idea to avoid extra heat, but several other team members, including Battlestar, ex-assassin Chen and ex-supervillain Sandman insisted that they all should stay to try and help her. Morty eventually arranged for Sable to be released and the charges dropped, thou she was no longer welcome in the United States, and she left for Castle Sable in Symkaria. Sam went there with Sable and most of the team. Not long after that, Sable notified Sam and the others that she had decided to no longer actively go on missions, and restricted herself to business activities, thou Sable returned to her previous position soon afterward.

samantha sheridan.name: Samantha Sheridan
samantha sheridan.origin: Samantha Sheridan is a young and beautiful geophysicist, and the great-granddaughter of elderly, wealthy Lady Amanda Sheridan, head of Sheridan Industries. Samantha had a brother and a baby sister, and at some point, she got engaged with fellow geophysicist Tom Foster. The amoral weapon manufacturing concern Deterrence Research Corporation, led by ruthless CEO Moses Magnum, was hired to develop a toxic biochemical gas to be used as a weapon, and Magnum arranged for it to be tested on kidnapped innocents in an undisclosed death camp in the jungles South America. Their victims included Samantha's parents, brother and baby sister, as well as her uncle Thomas Sheridan and his family, all of them dead in the swamps in unmarked graves. The Punisher and Spider-Man eventually found about the operation and stopped it, and the Punisher was believed to have killed Magnum himself (though Magnum secretly survived and escaped), but by then the kidnapped Sheridans were already dead, even if other prisoners were released. The Deterrence Research Corporation deflected any and all responsibility for the disaster, and continued with their activities, much to Lady Amanda and Samantha Sheridan's disappointment. Samantha went to work as an environmental consultant and earthquake specialist on the Alaska pipeline, along with her fiancé and colleage. Samantha discovered a thin fault running a mile off the tiny, supposedly uninhabited island Katsyu Shima in the Pacific Ocean, that connected the faults of Alaska and Japan. She also discovered tremors and pre-shocks from a supposedly tectonically-stable area, and published her discoveries. She then travelled to Tokyo, staying in Cherry Blossom Lane (an elegant borough of Tokyo protected by the police), to continue her research, while Tom Foster apparently remained in Alaska. Samantha's discoveries were due to Moses Magnum secretly using a huge laser drill to pierce a 1,500-mile pit toward the Earth's core in Katsyu Shima, which was on a particularly thin area of the Earth's crust, in an attempt to submit that point to a high pressure to cause earthquakes at will through Japan and the American west coast for profit. Magnum's computers however had failed to warn him about any tremor in his own area, yet they were wrong, so Magnum decided to kidnap an expert geophysicist whom to question on the specific effects of the pressure. Finding about Samantha, he decided to kidnap her. Magnum's plans were secretly opposed by the Council, a secret conspiracy led by Edward Buckman whose own interests were threatened by Magnum's plan. The Council infiltrated several of his own agents among Magnum's commando forces, and ordered them to stop Magnum from using Samantha's expertise. fields.notes: When retelling the story of Power Man Annual #1, both and (Moses Magnum's profiles) mistakenly say that Power Man rescued Amanda Sheridan, hired by her grandmother. In the story, he rescues Samantha Sheridan, not Amanda, and was hired by Samantha's great-grandmother Amanda. In Power Man Annual #1, Amanda says that his grandson Thomas and his family were killed by Moses Magnum. In Spider-Woman #34, Amanda's great-granddaughter Samantha says that her parents and siblings were killed by Moses Magnum. This may be interpreted as Thomas being Samantha's father - but in that case, Amanda's sentence would be misleading, "My grandson's family, Cage -- murdered by Moses Magnum", as not all of his family had been murdered. This article thus assumes that Thomas is not Samantha's father, and that Moses killed both Thomas and Samantha's father (who was also Thomas' brother). Samantha mentions her fiancé Tom Foster in (1976). Tom Foster made his first appearance 30 years later in (2006).

samhain.name: Samhain
samhain.first_appearance: Vision and the Scarlet Witch Vol 1 1
samhain.origin: The spirit of the deceased Thornn captured the Scarlet Witch and brought her into a supernatural dimension ruled by a mystical entity known as Samhain. There she encountered the spirits of the rest of Salem's Seven (except for Gazelle), who all sought vengeance upon her, intended to return to Earth, and were now allied with Samhain. There the Scarlet Witch also discovered Harkness' spirit, which had been bound helplessly to an ethereal stake ever since her physical demise, but Harkness had mystically contacted the Vision, telling him how to help fight Samhain by destroying a book of druidic magic to which Samhain was mystically bound. By doing so, the Vision made it impossible for Samhain to retain his humanoid form. With the entity's loss of Samhain's form, Harkness broke free from the stake and used her magical powers to entrap it within the spirits of his allies, the six members of Salem's Seven other than Gazelle. Harkness' spirit went free, and the Scarlet Witch returned to Earth.

sammael.name: Sammael
sammael.origin: Sammael was an Angel of Heaven who was cast out, and became a demon in Hell. In modern days, he regularly welcomed his formerly fellow Angel Armaziel to play a board game that represented on a chess-like table the struggle between Hell and Heaven's forces, for over three decades. The game was once disturbed by a nearly unbrained demon who grabbed a few pieces, causing various effects including the transformation of Jason Maldonado into Soulfire. Sammael restored the board after that tampering, adding new pieces to replace those now unusable, and Armaziel came to play another round. There, she played the "birthright of the prodigal incarnate" and, as the "penultimate movements [were] completed" retreated to Heaven.

sammy binion.name: Sammy Binion
sammy binion.origin: Sammy Binion, along with his brother Lou Binion, inherited a congenital heart condition from their father. Bribing a doctor to let him and his brother into the Green Berets, Sammy and Lou developed a reputation for being deadly killers. As soldiers, he and Lou developed drug habits before they returned to life as civilians, but in time, they set up a company based in New York City called the Binion Brothers Hauling and Storage Company. Together, they engaged in shady business with their emploees, including Harold Carstairs, and other corrupt companies, like Fulton Fish, owned by drug distributor Benedict Closet.

sammy stone.name: Sammy Stone
sammy stone.origin: Sammy Stone was a police officer operating in Los Angeles. She would frequently come to the Nickel Diner and chat with Frank Castle. Stone became disillusioned with the current justice system after her suspension for shooting a suspect fleeing a robbery, further exacerbated when Lou was assaulted by members of the Dos Soles Cartel. She decided to strike out and become a vigilante; however, she was caught and arrested while roughing up those who had beaten her friend. Escaping from prison with the help of Hector Del Sol, Stone became violent and insane, ultimately learning Frank Castle and the Punisher were one and the same. Vowing revenge on him for ruining her city, she confronted the Punisher in an alley, assuming the name Memento, and stabbing both him and his coyote, Loot, leaving them for dead.

samson strongman.name: Samson (Strongman)
samson strongman.origin: Samson was the strong man that worked at Pop's Circus during the 1940's. He was a brutish man who believed that he was more valuable to the circus than he really was. When the circus's young fire-eater Thomas Raymond discovered that he had flame powers when meeting the Human Torch, Pop would believe that the boys abilities would make a fortune for the circus. Overhearing this, Samson would scoff at the idea, pointing out that Pops hadn't paid him the promised bonus after his last performance. This, however, turned out to because Samson had fouled up during his last performance. Insulted by Samson's words, Pops would fire him and demand that he get off the circus lot. Samson would take his recent unemployment to try to take a shot at his former employer however the Human Torch would get in the way. While Samson would have the upper hand, the Torch would use his flame powers to end the fight, forcing Samson to get off the lot. Not willing to let things be, Samson would plot to get revenge against Pops by ruining Toro's premiere show. He would hire men to set loose caged animals in the hopes that they would attack the audience, but Toro's quick thinking and flame powers would see the animals replaced in their cages. Furious at this failure, Samson would decide to go and deal with Pops and his circus directly. Sneaking onto the circus property, Samson would confront the local scientist and demand he turns over his new invention, a Rayon Gun. When the scientist would refuse, Samson would shoot him in cold blood. Deciding to rob the box-office profits for the night, Samson would break into the box office. However, his attempted robbery would be noticed by the Human Torch and Toro who would attempt to stop him. Samson would use the Rayon Gun, which would negate their flame powers. However, despite this handicap, the Human Torch would be able to best Samson in combat turning him over to the guards on site, and then going after Samson's minions and capturing them as well.

samson barrick.name: Samson Barrick
samson barrick.origin: King Cobra was an enterprising criminal who in 1944 attempted to steal secret plans for a new bomber being designed by John Harvey. When King Cobra broke into Harvey's house, Harvey called his friend James Bennett to try alert him of his impending death but was gunned down. King Cobra then began ransacking Harvey's home searching for the plans unaware that Bennett's niece Madeline Joyce was flying to scene in her costumed guise of Miss America to investigate the murder. Catching King Cobra and his men in the act, Miss America attacked them but was knocked out from behind. King Cobra and his men then fled the scene empty handed, but realizing that Mr. Bennett was the likely recipient of the plans, King Cobra then sent his men to attack him. By that time James -- who was the executor of John's will -- was going over his late friends paperwork with Madeline when the King Cobra's men attacked. They stole the will and brought it back to King Cobra. Reading that all of Harvey's possessions were willed to his pet goldfish, the King Cobra realized that the fish might be where the plans were hidden. Before they could return to the Bennett home Miss America then arrived at their base. Stunning the heroine with a Tommy gun, King Cobra then tied Miss America up in a room full of TNT and left her to die. Arriving at Bennett's home, King Cobra then threatened Jim until Miss America escaped her death trap and came for her uncle's rescue. Miss America then knocked out King Cobra with the fish bowl he sought to steal, knocking him out. She then made short work of King Cobra's gang and turned them all over to the authorities. She then revealed to her uncle that King Cobra sought the plans which were sewed into a pouch on the goldfish. King Cobra's subsequent fate is unknown.

samson green.name: Samson Green
samson green.origin: Samson "Scars" Green was the leader of a group of unscrupulous mercenaries. It was comprised mostly of former Hydra agents, mixed in with a few former U.L.T.I.M.A.T.U.M. and S.H.I.E.L.D. soldiers. They contracted out to the highest bidders, carrying out bloody assignments without asking questions, from assassinations to government coups. Because of their M.O., somebody put a hit out on Scars and his mercenary outfit. Deadpool took the job, and since he had also agreed on an assingment to kill warlord Shuten Döji, he had Weasel set up Scars. Scars was tricked into thinking he had been hired to kill Shuten, and Weasel made the necessary arrangements for Deadpool to join them. Minutes before Deadpool, Scars and his team arrived to Shuten's castle in Bagalia by plane, Deadpool turned on the other mercenaries and killed them. He later strapped their corpses to jetpacks and launched them at Shuten Döji's castle to create a distraction.

samson rourke.name: Samson Rourke
samson rourke.species: Human mutated in a lab accident
samson rourke.origin: Genetics researcher Samson Rourke was mutated in a lab accident. His father, Manuel, tried to help him, but Samson succumbed to desperation and ran away. He joined a street gang and became their protector. On Manhattan's Avenue A, Samson helped the gang rob a businessman until John Jameson, clad in battle armor, attacked them. As the gang fled, Samson tore off Jameson's blaster and started to throttle him, but Jameson got the upper hand and stunned him before slapping a pair of electro-cuffs on him. Jameson surrendered him into his father's custody, who promised to arrange treatment for him.

samson washington.name: Samson Washington
samson washington.origin: Washington was an ex-circus strongman and Rhodes scholar who was hired by Spymaster to join his Espionage Elite. He and the other Espionage Elite members aided Spymaster in stealing secrets from Stark Industries. They came into conflict with Iron Man, Mike O'Brien, and some security guards. They were defeated and captured with the exception of Spymaster. Washington and the team were later reunited by Spymaster in order to hack Iron Man's armor. However, the hacker Spymaster hired, Glitch, chose to turn on the team, allowing the Espionage Elite to be captured. Spymaster escaped but was later captured.

samuel alexander.name: Samuel Alexander
samuel alexander.species: Alien/Human Hybrid who found his father's old Nova Corps Black Ops helmet
samuel alexander.origin: ===Origins=== While searching for his missing father, Jesse Alexander, Sam fell off his skateboard and hit his head. When he woke he discovered Gamora and Rocket Raccoon standing over his hospital bed. They too were searching for Jesse and his Black Nova helmet. After discovering Jesse's helmet, Gamora and Rocket Raccoon began to teach Sam how to use a Nova helmet. While training with Gamora and Rocket Raccoon, Sam flew to the Moon. There, he had an encounter with Uatu The Watcher who showed him an incoming Chitauri armada that was headed towards Earth. Sam was trained by both Gamora and Rocket Raccoon how to properly use his helmet in order to one day live up to his father's legacy. He was eventually able to beat them both and was deemed worthy to apprehend the Watcher's task. They sent Sam as a scout to gather information on the invading force. Right when he found the Chitauri, somewhere near Jupiter, they fired, leaving Sam "unconscious." When the Chitauri went to extract Sam into their ship, he revealed to them he was faking and quickly sped off. He went through one of the enemy ships and found the Ultimate Nullifier. He took it and then attempted to run through the mothership, disabling all soldiers. He was thwarted by Titus, a former Nova and ally of his father. Despite what Sam's father had told him, Jesse left the Supernovas when they needed him most and many of them lost their lives because of him. Titus was shot in the eye and arm and then made a trade with Chitauri, his life for all the Nova's secrets and weapons. Sam was infuriated and radiated a light so powerful that it stunned Titus and many Chitauri and escaped to Earth. thumb|left|Sam Alexander wielding the Ultimate Nullifier Titus followed him there and was eventually stopped the Ultimate Nullifier. Sam had developed a friendship with Uatu and revealed to him that he is the only person he feels comfortable talking to. When Sam returned home he expresses his doubt of his fathers supposed death. Whom is being held captive by the Chitauri on another planet. ===Avengers vs. X-Men=== At some point before the Avengers' war against the X-Men, Sam came to the planet Birj, trying to warn its people of the coming of the Phoenix Force. Instead, he battled Terrax, who refused to leave his planet. He managed to escape the destruction caused by the Phoenix, and fled to Earth, to warn of the coming of the Phoenix Force. thumb|right|Sam's arrival Sam eventually arrived on Earth, though he accidentally crashed into a plane. Stunned, he crash-landed on the ground and was discovered by the Avengers, although Hawkeye mistook him for a different Nova. Injured, all Sam could tell the Avengers was that "it" was coming, before falling into a coma. Unknown to him, a small portion of the Phoenix Force's energy was left on his uniform, which Iron Man analyzed and managed to confirm that the cosmic force was heading towards Earth. After he recovered from the landing, Nova joined the Avengers and the X-Men in the final battle against the Dark Phoenix, who commented on his possible alien heritage. Although he too couldn't help to defeat the Phoenix, his bravery led to him being offered a place in the Avengers by Thor. On his way back home, Sam was ambushed by Diamondhead, who bore a grudge against Sam's predecessor Richard Rider and, by association, anyone in the Nova Corps. Though Diamondhead was easily able to shrug off Sam's attacks due to him lacking the power and experience that Rider had, Sam was ultimately able to fend off his aggressor by blinding him with a flash of light and leaving him stranded on a high plateau in the desert. ===Post-AvX=== thumb|200 px|left|Sam Alexander reminiscing on his recent past as the Nova Nova asked his Mom if he could be an Avenger to which she initially replied "no." After a small speech by her, she finally decides not to stand in his way and that if he wanted to still fight crime, she wouldn't stop him. In his everyday school life, Sam was also having some trouble settling into regular life. When he found himself in a confrontation with school bully Karl, he forgot how normal he really was. In one instance, Karl threw a punch at Sam. Sam leaned back, dodging it, but fell on his back forgetting he couldn't fly. He found it even more difficult to keep his secret identity from his crush, Carrie. The same night that his mom talked to him about being Nova, he decided to go out for some fun by looking for villains in New York. While there, he met up with Spider-Man. Spider-Man then gave him some advice about crime fighting. Following this advise, he went back to the skate park that he destroyed and tried to be a hero for the people who were burdened with the job of cleaning it all up. ===Infinity=== thumb|150 px|right|Sam Alexander accidentally removing his helmet mid-flight After the skate park was rebuilt Sam encountered his crush, Carrie. Sam was caught off-guard when she told him that she knew that he was Nova. He then flew away i

fields.history: ===Origins=== While searching for his missing father, Jesse Alexander, Sam fell off his skateboard and hit his head. When he woke he discovered Gamora and Rocket Raccoon standing over his hospital bed. They too were searching for Jesse and his Black Nova helmet. After discovering Jesse's helmet, Gamora and Rocket Raccoon began to teach Sam how to use a Nova helmet. While training with Gamora and Rocket Raccoon, Sam flew to the Moon. There, he had an encounter with Uatu The Watcher who showed him an incoming Chitauri armada that was headed towards Earth. Sam was trained by both Gamora and Rocket Raccoon how to properly use his helmet in order to one day live up to his father's legacy. He was eventually able to beat them both and was deemed worthy to apprehend the Watcher's task. They sent Sam as a scout to gather information on the invading force. Right when he found the Chitauri, somewhere near Jupiter, they fired, leaving Sam "unconscious." When the Chitauri went to extract Sam into their ship, he revealed to them he was faking and quickly sped off. He went through one of the enemy ships and found the Ultimate Nullifier. He took it and then attempted to run through the mothership, disabling all soldiers. He was thwarted by Titus, a former Nova and ally of his father. Despite what Sam's father had told him, Jesse left the Supernovas when they needed him most and many of them lost their lives because of him. Titus was shot in the eye and arm and then made a trade with Chitauri, his life for all the Nova's secrets and weapons. Sam was infuriated and radiated a light so powerful that it stunned Titus and many Chitauri and escaped to Earth. thumb|left|Sam Alexander wielding the Ultimate Nullifier Titus followed him there and was eventually stopped the Ultimate Nullifier. Sam had developed a friendship with Uatu and revealed to him that he is the only person he feels comfortable talking to. When Sam returned home he expresses his doubt of his fathers supposed death. Whom is being held captive by the Chitauri on another planet. ===Avengers vs. X-Men=== At some point before the Avengers' war against the X-Men, Sam came to the planet Birj, trying to warn its people of the coming of the Phoenix Force. Instead, he battled Terrax, who refused to leave his planet. He managed to escape the destruction caused by the Phoenix, and fled to Earth, to warn of the coming of the Phoenix Force. thumb|right|Sam's arrival Sam eventually arrived on Earth, though he accidentally crashed into a plane. Stunned, he crash-landed on the ground and was discovered by the Avengers, although Hawkeye mistook him for a different Nova. Injured, all Sam could tell the Avengers was that "it" was coming, before falling into a coma. Unknown to him, a small portion of the Phoenix Force's energy was left on his uniform, which Iron Man analyzed and managed to confirm that the cosmic force was heading towards Earth. After he recovered from the landing, Nova joined the Avengers and the X-Men in the final battle against the Dark Phoenix, who commented on his possible alien heritage. Although he too couldn't help to defeat the Phoenix, his bravery led to him being offered a place in the Avengers by Thor. On his way back home, Sam was ambushed by Diamondhead, who bore a grudge against Sam's predecessor Richard Rider and, by association, anyone in the Nova Corps. Though Diamondhead was easily able to shrug off Sam's attacks due to him lacking the power and experience that Rider had, Sam was ultimately able to fend off his aggressor by blinding him with a flash of light and leaving him stranded on a high plateau in the desert. ===Post-AvX=== thumb|200 px|left|Sam Alexander reminiscing on his recent past as the Nova Nova asked his Mom if he could be an Avenger to which she initially replied "no." After a small speech by her, she finally decides not to stand in his way and that if he wanted to still fight crime, she wouldn't stop him. In his everyday school life, Sam was also having some trouble settling into regular life. When he found himself in a confrontation with school bully Karl, he forgot how normal he really was. In one instance, Karl threw a punch at Sam. Sam leaned back, dodging it, but fell on his back forgetting he couldn't fly. He found it even more difficult to keep his secret identity from his crush, Carrie. The same night that his mom talked to him about being Nova, he decided to go out for some fun by looking for villains in New York. While there, he met up with Spider-Man. Spider-Man then gave him some advice about crime fighting. Following this advise, he went back to the skate park that he destroyed and tried to be a hero for the people who were burdened with the job of cleaning it all up. ===Infinity=== thumb|150 px|right|Sam Alexander accidentally removing his helmet mid-flight After the skate park was rebuilt Sam encountered his crush, Carrie. Sam was caught off-guard when she told him that she knew that he was Nova. He then flew away i
fields.personality: Sam was a disbeliever, thinking his dad's stories of being an intergalactic policeman were nothing but nonsense and subsequently viewing his dad as a loser. Despite this, he still cared for his father. Sam, being only 16 years old, is still a child and acts immaturely in some situations. He also is very arrogant due to his powerful abilities.
powers: Sam has shown the ability to see the map of dead Novas even without his helmet, though it is unknown if he has any direct connection to the Nova Force.
weaknesses: Power Loss: His powers are dependent on his Helmet. Memory Disorder: Since his battle with Kluh, he suffers memory disorders.
fields.notes: Although his helmet corresponds to the rank of Denarian in the Nova Corps, the rest of his costume corresponds to that of a Centurion, like other Supernovas.
fields.trivia: He enjoys listening to dubstep music and watching SportsCenter on ESPN. Sam also seems to be a fan of Snickers candy bars and "the Cardinals", which may be the Arizona Cardinals football team considering Arizona is the state he was born in. Jeph Loeb named Sam after his son, who had died of bone cancer at the age of 17. Sam is very possessive of his Nova Corps helmet because when his father, Jesse, "died" all Sam had left was his helmet. He expresses the most care for it in , where his last conscious thought is that they can't take off the helmet, and in . where Diamondhead's comment about taking the helmet as a trophy is what pushes Sam to keep on fighting. Nova fans are often referred to as "NovaNauts" and "Novanators" in the solicitations for the series' issues. After getting shot in , Sam's bullet wound itches. Sam is a member of the Forums social media network. He also has a Roxx On! app.
