sandra brockhurst.name: Sandra Brockhurst
sandra brockhurst.origin: Sandy Brockhurst and her mother were passing by a gas station in Arizona. While her mother was filling her car's tank, Sandy went into the station to buy a drink for the road. Shortly afterwards, Tommy Hill entered the store to rob it. When Sandy noticed him, she dropped the juice bottle into the floor, causing Tommy to panick and shoot her. He also shot another witness, Bruce Banner, and the counterman, Josh Alfaro, before fleeing. When he returned to life as the Hulk, Bruce tracked down Tommy Hill and beat him up within an inch of his life for Sandy's death.

sandra murphy.name: Sandra Murphy
sandra murphy.origin: Sandra Murphy was a descendant of the ancient warrior king Arda Ulhaf, who slew the demon Aeshma. Sandra received the Mace of Aeshma from her father, Conrad Murphy. The mace had been handed down from generation to generation ever since Arda Ulhaf. ===Wheels Within Wheels=== Sandra was one of many superhumans known only to Nick Fury, who recorded their existence on what he referred to as his list of Caterpillars. The purpose of these Caterpillars was so Nick could have an untapped and untainted pool of potential agents should he ever need them. When the time came that he did need them to form his Secret Warriors, Mikel Fury and Carlos Ayala appeared at Sandra's home in Winthrop, Massachusetts to recruit her. ===Team Gray's final mission=== Sandra became a member of the Secret Warriors' Team Gray, led by Mikel. Their original task was to gather intelligence on Leviathan's activities, but the old Russian organization was seemingly inactive. It was not until the war between Leviathan and Hydra suddenly ignited with Orion, the leader of Leviathan, making his return that Team Gray's job heated up. The Secret Warriors were the third party in the fighting between Leviathan and Hydra, and losses were severe for all parties. A civil war broke out inside of Hydra, secretly orchestrated by Nick and his brother Jake Fury. Team Gray were sent in to take out the Hive's stronghold in the Indian Ocean, one of the last remaining Hydra strongholds. This mission went badly, and Team Gray were overrun by parasite-infected Hydra soldiers. They succeeded in destroying the stronghold, but all of Team Gray died in the process, including Sandra.

sandra pierce.name: Sandra Pierce
sandra pierce.origin: Sandra "Sandy" Pierce is the daughter of oil baron, Henry Pierce. As a child in the 1920s she met and befriended Prince Namor on the beach. Years later as a teenager, she reunited with her friend and discovered his Atlantean origin. While worried at first, she began to accept his life and eventually fell in love with him. Her father's oil drilling in the ocean caused Atlantis to become overpopulated. Realizing that her father would continue to make more oil drilling machinery, she decided to join Namor and the Atlanteans in finding a new home. Due to her human physiology, it is possible that she eventually died of old age.

sandra verdugo.name: Sandra Verdugo
sandra verdugo.origin: Sandy was a former Special Forces agent who worked for Home Base, helping them track Bruce Banner. She met Doc Samson in Argentina while on a mission, and, unbeknownst, to him, became pregnant with his child. She lived in seclusion with their child, Ricky, for eight years until Home Base kidnapped him and framed her for his murder to employ her services. She was executed for the murder of her son, and from there, Home Base transferred her consciousness into a superhuman clone. She worked for them alongside Jink Slater tracking Bruce Banner. When they finally caught up to him, she turned against her partner, siding with Bruce (who had also been framed for Ricky's murder). She and Bruce discussed how they were both framed, and she seemingly died again in a cabin explosion. She revived and unburied herself, and found Banner again, this time helping him escape another Home Base agent. Sandy eventually went to Samson and revealed that Ricky was his son and was missing, and Doc was able to track him to one of Home Base's facilities. After reuniting with him, both Sandy and Ricky seemed to die when Hulk destroyed the facility, but due to her abilities, this remains to be seen.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.origin: Sandstorm was a former American soldier who had fought in the Middle East. During this time, he was chemically mutated by his opponents. He gained the powers to control sand and quit the army and began to attack the Middle Eastern nation, as vengeance for his transformation and the death of his friend as Sandstorm. He attacked a small town in Saudi Arabia with a sandstorm, and attacked Arabian Knight. The pair fought, with Sandstorm gaining the upper hand and buried the Knight with sand, who was rescued by his carpet. Sandstorm was captured by the Knight's extending belt sash, and in doing so sealed his mouth. This someone lead to Sandstorm choking on the sand so the Knight saved him just as the Saudi's arrived to kill him, but he was again saved by the Arabian Knight and Sandstorm ceased his quest for vengeance after realizing the quest would be never-ending.

sandu.name: Sandu
sandu.origin: Sandu was an unremarkable fortune teller working at a travelling carnival. He used his abilities to steal from the audience, but his powers were limited. Loki the trickster god was watching the show and sensed the evil inside him. He decided to use him in his plans against his step-brother Thor. Loki used his Asgardian magic to increase Sandu's mental powers a thousand times over, granting him the power to gain as much wealth as he wanted. thumb|left|Sandu Sandu went on a crime spree: robbing banks, race tracks, trains, and museums. He teleported a palace and claimed it as his own. He then lifted the United Nations building, demanding that the representatives inside declare him ruler or be hurled into space. Thor battled him early in his post-Blake career. To help, Odin sent Megingjord via the Valkyries. Sandu transported himself and Mjolnir away. His attempts to lift the hammer however caused a mental short circuit. He was then defeated and taken into custody.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.origin: Sandwich was the name Peter Parker gave to a stray dog he found on the streets while patrolling the city as Spider-Man. He gained its trust by giving it a sandwich he found in a dumpster, hence the dog's name. thumb|left|Spider-Man swinging home with Sandwich Peter tried to keep Sandwich hidden at his Aunt May's house. However, she quickly found out about Sandwich and called animal control, arguing they couldn't keep a dog, much to Peter's disgruntlement. The dog was eventually taken away.

sandy sanders.name: Sandy Sanders
sandy sanders.origin: thumb|left|Younger Sanders and Duchman Along with Duke Duchman, Sandy Sanders was one of the astronauts originally positioned to launch the Marvel-1 with Reed Richards and Ben Grimm. When Richards took the Marvel-1 on an unauthorized flight that ended up transforming its tripulants into the Fantastic Four, Sue and Johnny Storm took the place of Sanders and Duchman, who had abandoned the project as they felt the spacecraft's radiation shielding was insufficient. Both Sanders and Duchman would go on to continue their careers, living a normal life and raising their own families. When the National Air and Space Museum mounted an exhibition for the Marvel-1, Sanders and Duchman were invited to its opening. They stumbled into Sue and Johnny, who expressed remorse for swiping their spot, preventing them from potentially having become super heroes. Sanders and Duchman brushed off their concern with contempt and expressed preference for their normal lives.

sandy sandlin.name: Sandy Sandlin
sandy sandlin.origin: Not much is known about United States Marshal Sandy Sandlin. At one point in his life, he clashed with outlaw Twist Staley and his Rustlers' Roost gang in Nevada, during which Sandlin was shot and left to die in the desert. Sandlin managed to survive, and eventually tracked Staley down in Northern Wyoming. After Staley and his crew failed to rustle a herd of cattle, they retreated to their hideout, where Sandlin was waiting. Sandlin shot gang member Little Augie dead, and took the remaining group into custody. Every member was sentenced to death by hanging. Sandlin's subsequent fate is unknown.

Like the other Grapplers, Butterball underwent the strength-augmentation process of the Power Broker, boosting her strength and durability to superhuman levels. sandy vincent.name: Sandy Vincent
sandy vincent.origin: Sandy Vincent was a political science graduate who got a job as a secretary at Roxxon Oil alongside her college friend Babs Bendix, though neither felt fulfilled in their jobs. Sandy, however, was scouted by Roxxon's research department. They wanted to use technology to give her superpowers, and she agreed. However, they also implanted her with a device called the Zed Control that would enable them to eliminate her if she became a problem or outlived her usefulness. Once given her abilities, Sandy became a super-agent for Roxxon, taking the name of Stratosfire. Publicly, she improved the company's public image by performing heroic acts, but secretly she used her powers to sabotage Roxxon's business rivals. Sandy enjoyed being a superhero, and worked alongside Iron Man. Babs, however, became suspicious about what her friend was becoming involved in, and through a mutual friend she approached Tony Stark with her concerns. However, Babs had been followed by she and Sandy's boss Jonas Hale, who saw her as a threat and had her killed. Realizing Roxxon were responsible for her friend's death, Sandy began attacking Roxxon facilities, and then targeted places she disapproved of, such as nuclear power stations and military bases, hoping to make the world better. In an attempt to stop her rampage, Iron Man teamed up with Sunturion, a predecessor of Stratosfire as a Roxxon agent with similar powers. When Stratosfire tried to stop a space shuttle from delivering a payload of star wars defense technology, Iron Man and Sunturion opposed her, and Jonas Hale tried to activate the Zed Control, but failed. Turning into an energy form, Sunturion reached inside Stratosfire's body and activated the Zed Control, killing her.

sandy york.name: Sandy York
sandy york.origin: When Sandy York was a student at Thames University, he was friends with fellow students Brian Braddock, Courtney Ross, and Jacko Tanner. He often hung out with them at a local pub called the Flying Finish that was owned by Dora. One night at the pub Jacko had just insulted Brian to Courtney, much to her annoyance. Sandy then began questioning Jacko's intelligence, but he annoyed Courtney as well. Later when Courtney was looking for Brian to have a breakfast date, she spoke with Sandy about it and he told her Brian's activities that morning at the university gymnasium. In fact, Sandy kept track of almost all of Brian's activities. Sandy was a keen photographer whose ambition was to sell photos to the newspapers. He was unwittingly instrumental in Captain Britain figuring out that Hurricane's suit was nuclear-powered, as all of his photographs of the Hurricane had been overexposed due to the radiation.

sanford harte.name: Sanford Harte
sanford harte.origin: Senator Sanford summoned General Hill to Washington and told him that funding for his department had been cut following the debacle of his compromised safe house, while backing Nazi sympathizer and ICON member Geoffrey Sydenham. Senator Sanford arranges for General Hill to meet with Geoffrey Sydenham to convince him to join ICON but without managing to undermine the General's beliefs which he categorically refused despite Sydenham's threats. At the end of Sydenham's plot in Washington, DC, Harte told him that he had supported him from the beginning even accepting the intervention of his group of Nazis because as he intended it would save the world but after what was happening Harte replied that he had no signed to fight his war, but just then Nick Fury intervened with his Avengers who opposed Sydenham and his men, defeating them. Despite everything, however, Harte still managed to get away from the charge of treason.

sanford williams.name: Sanford Williams
sanford williams.origin: Sanford Williams was an industrialist who founded a highly successful munition factory called Williams Innovations. He lived with his wife Martha Williams in a suburb house in Paterson, New Jersey. When he had his first son, Eric, with his wife, Sanford had tried to raise "his" son using his own, tough methods, but failed to control him properly and Eric grew up to become a loutish rebel. Then, when their second son, Simon, was born, Martha refused to let Sanford repeat the mistake and insisted on raising Simon herself, giving the kids the idea that Eric had been born bad, especially after Eric harmed the family cat in front of the family one 4th of July. Leaving Eric to Sanford's untender attentions, Martha told Simon that Eric was evil, Sanford was useless, and she herself was weak, so Simon was left with the burden of stopping Eric when the latter was to do an evil deed, lest it'd be Simon's fault. While being more involved in Eric's upbringing, Sanford was a hard and stern father to both of his sons, never satisfied with their achievements, and even prone to physically punishing them. While both kids tried to earn their father's approval, Eric also tended toward an athletic, risk-taking approach while Simon was shy and studious, yet even then, Sanford offered only a frown at Simon's A-minus result in math. Simon noticed that his father liked chess and, in an attempt to approach Sanford and speak to him, Simon learned chess and obtained some skill. Sanford had wanted his eldest son to learn the business and eventually join Williams Innovations, but Eric refused. Simon did not turn his nose up when he was the second choice. left|thumb|Sanford Williams' death At one time, a still-young Eric had an accident at the family home while playing with dangerous fluids in the garage, and accidentally caused the house to burn down, apparently causing Sanford's death. Later, when Simon was only 22 years old, he took over Williams Innovations, but failed to keep the company competitive, eventually embezzling money from his own company and starting a series of events that turned Simon into the superhuman Avenger Wonder Man - and his brother Eric into the supervillain Grim Reaper. Many of Williams Innovations' assets ended up in the hands of criminal syndicate Maggia. For a long time, Martha tried to stay away from her superpowered children's activities, though she opened up to them when the Avengers, looking for clues on where to find the Grim Reaper, visited her. Sanford's soul, along with a soul that looked like Martha's, were captured by the demon Blackheart, in an attempt to coerce Wonder Man to join forces with Blackheart against the latter's father, the demon Mephisto. Blackheart believed that Wonder Man would be willing to help because, should Mephisto beat Blackheart, he would also probably destroy Sanford and Martha. However, Blackheart found out that Mephisto had already captured Wonder Man, so he teleported with the captured souls and the Grim Reaper's to Mephisto's lair, to fight him for Wonder Man's soul. During the battle, Mephisto's demons threatened to devour Sanford and the false Martha, and Blackheart offered to save their souls - but Wonder Man believed that this would only keep them in hell, and instead made the souls vanish into oblivion.

sangor.name: Sangor
sangor.origin: King Sangor was the ruler of Molivia whose kingdom was invaded in 1940 by the nation of Torpis, a dictatorship ruled by Kalph Belgri. Learning of the invasion, Professor Philo Zog sent some of his operatives in the area to deploy his robot Electro to assist the Molivians in fighting off Belgri's invasion. King Sangor welcomed the operatives and allowed them to use his palace as there headquarters.

sangre.name: Sangre
sangre.origin: ===First Generation=== The Children of the Vault are post-humans who evolved in a temporally sealed vault within the Conquistador for 6000 years. The Vault was designed to remain closed until some global catastrophe erased humanity, however an energy released during the M-Day affected the Vault and opened it earlier. Sangre lead several Children out of the Vault and after discovering that the Earth was still inhabited, they decided to eradicate all humans and mutants so their species could inherit the planet like they were meant to. As leader of the Children of the Vault, Sangre was a ruthless man. While he normally worked in the background, he was an intelligent leader and well-respected by his teammates. He took his work very seriously and was most concerned with the survival of his race. After Serafina revealed herself to the X-Men, Sangre decided to launch an attack on the group. When the mutants fought back, they foiled the plan to destroy the Xavier Institute, and Mystique shot Sangre with thermite bullets, which turned the water in his body to air when they exploded, killing him. ===Second Generation=== Remaining members of the Children of the Vault moved into the Vault in Ecuador built within the ruins of the Wild Sentinel Factory, whose temporal nature was always changing. The City, the artificial intelligence that ran the Vault, analyzed the defeat of the first generation, and created an upgraded and more powerful second generation of the Children, including a new Sangre. They left the Vault, but were captured by Orchis, killed and dissected. ===Third Generation=== The second generation's Serafina managed to escape from Orchis and return into the Vault, and the City decided to create a third generation. However, before it was able to do it, the Vault was attacked by the X-Men and infiltrated by Wolverine, Synch, and Darwin. To protect itself, the City revived the first generation of the Children. First generation's Sangre was killed again, by Synch using the pyrokinetic powers of Fuego. The City eventually still created a third generation of the Children, including Sangre.

sanity claws.name: Sanity Claws
sanity claws.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 7
sanity claws.origin: An old anthropomorphic polar bear who delivered gifts to children yearly, Sanity Claws had repeated bouts of insanity whenever he donned stocking caps due to the elastic bands pressing his brain too much. He repeatedly clashed with superhero Deerdevil, first when Claws began a spree of entering homes through chimneys to steal milk and cookies and fill in socks drawers with coals; and later when he began a cult. Once Deerdevil removed his cap, Claws recovered and even forgot his criminal deeds.

sanjay.name: Sanjay
sanjay.first_appearance: Fear Itself: Hulk vs. Dracula Vol 1 1
sanjay.origin: A warrior vampire recruited into Raizo Kodo's Forgiven, a group of heroic vampires. When a Nul-possessed Hulk landed in Romania and began assaulting the stronghold of Dracula in an effort to spread fear worldwide, Ghost Blade and the Forgiven offered their assistance. Though initially imprisoned, the group broke free and actively attempted to prevent the Hulk from destroying the gathered vampires, while saving civilians in the nearby town of Pasnic. Ghost Blade was defeated by Hulk after he entered his mist form and was blown away by Hulk. Recovering, Ghost Blade and his allies tried one final tactic to stop the Hulk, ramming twin trains into him. Though unsuccessful, Kodo and teammate Inka managed to successfully stop the Hulk through use of a Claw sect illusion. Stealing the Hammer of Nul from Dracula, the Forgiven continued their actions in Transylvania, hunting a group of Nosferatu who were terrorizing the area. When Valkyrie came to the cabin the Forgiven, including Ghost Blade, were staying in, Raizo dueled her and eventually gave to her the hammer. Ghost Blade later assisted the other Forgiven in attempting to break X-Man Jubilee of her dependency on human blood and disabled Domino when the X-Men arrived seeking their teammate.

santa claus.name: Santa Claus
santa claus.species: Mutant manifested by spiritual energy in reaction to humanity's belief in him
santa claus.origin: ===Legend=== Santa Claus is a legendary figure who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on Christmas. Unknown to the people on Earth, Santa Claus was given being because of humanity's belief in the deeds of four different characters in history. These four people, whom belief in together created the true magical being of Santa Claus, are who the people of Earth posit Santa Claus actually is or originated from. ===First of five: Old Winter=== One of the five characters that that led to the origin of Santa Claus was the being "Old Winter" from pre-medieval Britain. It is said that there was a custom among tribes for the community elder to dress up in furs as the aforementioned "Old Winter", and go from dwelling to dwelling delivering food and drink. It was thought that if someone was hospitable to Old Winter, the winter season would be kind to them. This tradition survived for many, many, years, and after the introduction of Christianity, Old Winter began to be known as "Old Christmas", "Old Father Christmas", and eventually simply "Father Christmas". ===Second of five: Saint Nicholas=== Another of the five people whose deeds later inspired the belief that created Santa Claus was a 4th-century man named Saint Nicholas. Saint Nicholas was born near the coast of modern-day Turkey, and became the bishop of Myra in his life. Many miracles were attributed to him, and he was known to to be very kind, to be very generous, and to have a great love of children. Some of his miracles include appearing to Emperor Constantine in a dream once to save three wrongly accused soldiers from execution, and restoring three beheaded children of sailors back to life. The most famous story told of the bishop Nicholas is how he attempted to give money anonymously to a family of daughters whose father could not pay their dowries for them to get married. He tried tossing a bags of gold into their house on the nights the girls were to get married, and it is said that on the third night he dropped the bag through the chimney, where it landed in a stocking hanging out to dry. Despite Nicholas' wishes, word of his good deeds spread, and eventually whenever anyone received an unexpected gift, they began thanking Nicholas as custom. After Nicholas' death, a church was built in dedication of him. Hundreds of years later, after Myra's end, the Russian Emperor Vladimir decided to make Bishop Nicholas the patron saint of Russia after visiting Constantinople and hearing all the wonderful stories of him. These stories eventually spread to the Laplands, to the people of the reindeer sleds. In the Netherlands, the name Sint Nicolaas was contracted into Sinterklaas, which inspired the name Santa Claus. The day before the anniversary of Nicholas' death, December 5th, became a time of giving, which eventually became linked to Christmas, the December 25th Christian celebration of the birth of Jesus Christ. ===Third and fourth: Saint Basil and the Immortal Woodcarver=== In Eastern Orthodox Christian tradition, Santa Claus is associated with with a different 4th-century religious figure named Saint Basil. Basil was the archbishop of Caesarea (also in modern-day Turkey) and the Greek Eastern Orthodox have a tradition that Basil gives presents to children on January 1. This tradition was one of the five contributing beliefs that later led to Santa's generation. Another of the five contributing beliefs was focused around a generous medieval woodcarver in Europe who would travel from town to town to deliver homemade gifts. One year while delivering gifts he and his wife were trapped in a blizzard and they were rescued by elves. The elves explained that the woodcarver was their prophesied leader and they made him immortal. ===Final of the five: Odin=== 300px|right|thumb|Odin the Gift-Bringer The final belief that led to the creation of Santa Claus was inspired by the All-Father of Asgard (the realm of the gods), Odin after a special night in which he saved a village's Midwinter's feast from not happening. Hundreds of years ago, an Asgardian Troll named Grylak the Greater was attempting to blackmail Odin to give Grylak control of Asgard, threatening to destroy it with a giant asteroid otherwise. At the same time, on Earth, a fisherman named Sigurd was sailing home to his village's Midwinter's feast, but was caught in a storm that blotted out the stars and stopped Sigurd from being able to navigate home. Sigurd's wife, Sia, prayed to Odin to help her husband. In answer, Odin commanded his son, Thor, to not attack Grylak but to first gather some of Asgard's finest wines, linens, and foods. Afterward, accomplishing two goals at once, Odin ordered Thor to hurl his magic hammer, Mjolnir, at the Troll's asteroid; destroying it in a blinding flash of light that appeared as a bright star in the sky to Sigurd and his crew on Earth, allowing them to navigate home. fields.history: ===Legend=== Santa Claus is a legendary figure who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on Christmas. Unknown to the people on Earth, Santa Claus was given being because of humanity's belief in the deeds of four different characters in history. These four people, whom belief in together created the true magical being of Santa Claus, are who the people of Earth posit Santa Claus actually is or originated from. ===First of five: Old Winter=== One of the five characters that that led to the origin of Santa Claus was the being "Old Winter" from pre-medieval Britain. It is said that there was a custom among tribes for the community elder to dress up in furs as the aforementioned "Old Winter", and go from dwelling to dwelling delivering food and drink. It was thought that if someone was hospitable to Old Winter, the winter season would be kind to them. santi sardina.name: Santi Sardina
santi sardina.origin: 200px|thumb|left|Santi being ignored in class ===Origin=== Santi Sardina was an average student though generally teased, being called an awkward loser. He was uncomfortable in his own skin and enjoyed drawing, but had few other talents. ===Gloryhog=== When his mutant powers manifested, Santi began to receive a lot of praise and admiration for things he had not done. Initially, Santi enjoyed the positive attention, but quickly grew frustrated with the idea of being a fraud. With a little influence from David Haller, Santi began anonymously painting the "Losergiest" art series, a collection of raw work about dispossession, guilt, and pop-infused ambition. Santi later helped David disband the I.B.S.S./Darwin's Martyrs and foil the plans of the Red Skull.

santiago rivera.name: Santiago Rivera
santiago rivera.origin: Santiago Rivera was a military dictator who took control of the South American nation of San Diablo by military coup. Because of the fighting, there was a shortage of medical help in San Diablo, and several American doctors, including Dr. Donald Blake (with his trusty sidekick, nurse Jane Foster), agreed to go there to help out. However, the evil Executioner, leader of the communist faction, did not want the peasants to be treated. He wanted them to remain ill, so that they would be too weak to oppose the communists. He thus sent five fighter planes to blow up the ship carrying the doctors and medical supplies from America. Blake turned into Thor and destroyed the planes, which prompted the Executioner to send the commander of the pilots to the firing squad. The Executioner then sent his armed forces to hunt down and kill the doctors. Thor fought off all attackers, but then the soldiers captured Jane Foster, forcing Thor to back off. The communists fawned over Jane, until Blake arrived demanding her release. Angered over Blake's commands, The Executioner stole his walking stick and ordered Blake in front of the firing squad. However, Blake goaded the Executioner into fighting him man to man, snatched back his stick and transformed into Thor. As Thor fought off the attacking communists, the army of the Democratic Faction arrived, causing the communists to flee. Realizing his defeat was imminent, the Executioner stole the gold from the treasury and attempted to flee. The other communists recognized him as a traitor and placed him in front of their own firing squad. They then realized that the Americans were their friends all along, and every was happy. Blake then treated and cured all of the sick peasants, and of course, no one suspected any connection between he and Thor (although Jane wished Don could be more brave and adventurous like Thor).

santo vaccarro.species: Mutant, later revealed to also be a Psionic Entity not requiring a body at all times
santo vaccarro.origin: ===Origin=== Santo Vaccarro was born in Boston, Massachusetts. Even as a child he was much bigger and stronger than other kids. Parents made him believe that only the strong are respected, so he often bullied other kids to gain the fame of the strongest kid in the school. At a young age he joined wrestler and football teams and was very good at them and had a chance to become professional sportsmen. When his mutant powers manifested his entire body was transformed into rock and he became even bigger and stronger. Unlike with many other mutants, Santo's parents hadn't rejected him and had no problem with his new appearance. Others, however, now treated him as a freak and he was forced to leave athletic teams. ===Hellions=== thumb|left|Rockslide Santo was sent to the Xavier Institute where he befriended his roommate Julian Keller. He was originally advised by Iceman, but was later selected by Emma Frost to be part of her Hellions Squad under the name Rockslide. Santo and the rest of the Hellions went on to win the Field Day Tournament and were declared the best squad at the end of the school year. During the summer vacation, Julian, from a well-to-do background, invited his friends to his home. The Hellions ran into trouble quickly, as his and Mercury's appearances along with Dust's dress disturbed people at the airport. After a brief struggle, the group was allowed to board, and made their way to Julian's home in California. Soon, the team encountered the Kingmaker, from whom they each received a trial wish. Santo's wish was to become a World-class Champion in superhuman wrestling. However, when the Hellions eventually refused a permanent deal with the Kingmaker, the Kingmaker shattered Santo with a laser blast. Julian used his telekinesis to piece Rockslide back together, and together the Hellions defeated the Kingmaker. ===Decimation & Childhood's End=== Soon after returning to the school after the vacation, the Scarlet Witch created the reality known as the House of M. In this reality, Santo was once again a champion superhuman wrestler. After the effects of M-Day, he was one of the few students who didn't lose their powers. The depowered students and staff were sent back to their homes. One bus was bombed by anti-mutant religious zealot Reverend William Stryker, and Santo's former teammate and friend Tag was among those killed. The X-Men held a funeral for those students whose parents would not accept them, and Santo reflected upon how he had "failed" by not being able to save those killed. With the mutant population drastically decreased, the government sent the Sentinel O*N*E* Squad to watch over the school, which began housing as many remaining mutants as would take refuge. All of the remaining students were placed by Emma Frost into an all-out brawl, and the ones deemed to be the best were to be assigned to become a group of in-training X-Men. Santo made the team and began training to become a X-Man. William Stryker continued his terrorist attacks against the school. Santo's teammate Elixir ended Stryker's plans by killing him. The New X-Men, with the help of Prodigy, then made the connection between Stryker and Nimrod. The team leader, Surge, then decided that the team would find and destroy the robot. When the team confronted Nimrod, Rockslide was obliterated in the battle. Hellion and Mercury tried desperately to awaken and to piece him back together, but Rockslide's remains were initially unresponsive. Thankfully, even in his shattered form he was able to survive, and was finally put back together, only to become larger and more rugged than his previous form. Rockslide was later seen talking to Match and Anole about their abilities and how useful or non-useful they would be if they joined the New X-Men team, indicating Match and Anole may be possible candidates for admission onto the team. He was at the memorial service for all the students lost in Stryker's attack on the institute. ===Mercury Falling & Quest For Magik=== Rockslide accompanied the X-Men when they jumped from the Blackbird to save Mercury from the Facility. He helped with great enthusiasm during the fight, and in the aftermath, made fun of Shadowcat and her powers, saying that being an X-Man must be "really hard". Kitty then jokingly threatened to kill him. thumb|250px|left|Rockslide's new form Santo and the other students were captured by Belasco, and taken to Limbo. While hiding from Belasco, along with Blindfold, Match, Loa, Anole, Wolf Cub, Pixie, and Gentle, Santo was unsure what to do. As demons approached the group, Santo fought them off, but then seemingly exploded when he tried to shoot his fists at them. Santo reconstituted himself in a magma rock form impervious to magic and beat the badness out of Illyana, who then helped them to rescue their fellow students and kill Belasco. Back home Rockslide threatened to quit if Pixie and Anole weren't made part of the New X-Men. ===World War Hulk=== Rockslide was one of the New X

sapna.name: Sapna
sapna.origin: Sapna was a young mutant girl who was attacked by the Indian Military in Calcutta due to anti-Mutant hysteria caused by the M-Pox before being rescued by Magik, who took the girl and her parents to the Jean Grey School For Higher Learning, in X-Haven, to receive medical treatment. With the magical defenses put in X-Haven by Magik down, the Demons from the surrounding areas of Limbo started to attack the school. When her parents were about to be attacked by the Demons, Sapna's powers manifested and she somehow made the Demons stop attacking. Figuring out that she was able to control Demons, Sapna commanded them to help the X-Men against the other Demons and joined the fight. thumb|left|150px|Sapna's powers manifested After Forge activated X-Haven's shields, preventing the Demons from attacking the school, Sapna's parents left her with the X-Men and returned to their home for fearing her powers. Sapna, who had taken one of the demons as her pet and named it Boogers, brought to Magik's attention the existence of portals to other dimensions inside Limbo. Sapna was taken by Magik to the Sanctum Sanctorum, where Doctor Strange would help them understand the nature of Sapna's supernatural powers. Strange discovered Sapna's powers weren't magical but linguistic in nature, and that because her powers manifested in Limbo, she was able to absorb the realm's magical knowledge. However, Strange detected something else within the girl. Accompanied by Magik, Strange entered Sapna's mind and discovered an unknown creature there. The creature attacked and subdued the pair, but Sapna managed to cast a spell to dissipate the creature. As Sapna feared the creature's return, Magik told her not to worry but Strange revealed to her that the creature wasn't after Sapna but after her. While the X-Men were in the future rescuing Colossus and his team of young mutants, Sapna was being trained by Magik, who wanted to know what else Sapna could do with her powers, in X-Haven. After the training, Magik gave her old X-Men costume to her as a gift. Since her powers first manifested, Sapna had been having nightmares in which she killed Magik using her Soulsword to do so. Fearing those nightmares were visions of what would happen if she stayed in X-Haven, Sapna fled from Limbo through a portal. This portal led her to the World-Eater, a powerful creature who had lured Sapna away from Limbo by promising to help her so it could use her as a host. thumb|left|Possessed by the World-Eater (Earth-616)|World-Eater Sapna was used by the World-Eater to lure Magik away from Limbo and steal her Soulsword, trapping her in another dimension while it went to Limbo in order to consume it. However, with the help of the Magical Resistance, a group formed by the last survivors of some of the many dimensions destroyed by the World-Eater, Magik managed to return to her realm and defeat the entity by killing Sapna, whose soul was preserved inside Magik's Soulsword. While Magik was helping the X-Men during a crisis against the Inhumans, Sapna communicated with her through the Soulsword and even forced Magik into the sword because she was feeling sad and alone. Magik managed to cast a spell afterwards which made Sapna appear in the real world as an apparition only she could see.

sappers hazards.name: Sappers (Hazards)
sappers hazards.first_appearance: Habit Heroes and Iron Man Vol 1 1
sappers hazards.origin: The Sappers are granite-rock like creatures who are the underground faction of the Habit Hazards. Usually fights occur between them and the other two groups, the Blocker Bots and the Scorchers, but they decided to work together by draining every kind of energy from New York City in order to open a portal to another dimension, hoping to release one of the greater powered Hazards who was banished from Earth. As their plan was working out in their favor, they were thwarted by members of Habit Heroes, and the armored Avenger, Iron Man. In retaliation, the Sappers combined with the other hazards to form a giant gestalt being but they were to late as Iron Man and the Heroes combined all their powers into one to destroy the giant and also prevented the other hazard from coming through the portal by closing it.

sapphire styx.name: Sapphire Styx
sapphire styx.origin: Sapphire was a mysterious woman who was a member of the gang of the Madripoorian criminal Roche. She met Wolverine while he was in Madripoor in the Princess Bar. She later found Wolverine him lying the street. She offered him a place at her home, but he refused. So, she began draining his life force by kissing him, but he punched her away. With help from Razor-Fist, she subdued Wolverine and drained him of his life force until he lost consciousness. Sapphire handed Wolverine over to Roche who has him tortured him. After watching the owner of the Princess Bar, O'Donnell, get tortured by Roche and drain him of his life force, Sapphire was shot by Tyger Tiger The two women fought each other until Tyger bit Sapphire's threat and burned her face with a heated iron. Tyger then lost consciousness, allowing Sapphire to escape. After stealing a box from Tyger Tiger, Sapphire encountered Wolverine who was hired by Tyger to retrieve the box. Sapphire attempted to seduce Wolverine, but he retrieved the box and beat her up. Wolverine left Sapphire with Tyger who planned to do something with her, though it was unrevealed what her punishment was. Years later, Sapphire and Viper joined the Femme Fatales and set up a trap for the X-Men, Domino, and Psylocke in Madripoor who were searching for clues in the disappearance of Wolverine. During the trap, Sapphire drained Psylocke of all of her life force, leaving her body dead. Psylocke's soul survived inside Sapphire Styx's mind, and fought its way back. With assistance from a fragment of Wolverine's soul which Sapphire Styx had absorbed years earlier, Psylocke psychically assaulted the villainess in retaliation for the countless of souls she had absorbed in her life. The strain caused Sapphire Styx to burst, resulting in her death. Using the remaining soul power left behind, Psylocke built herself a new body, molecule by molecule.

sara carr.origin: Trying to stop the destruction of reality following Fixer's death by his future self, the Thunderbolts tried to identify among the people who died following the appearance of the Thunderbolts Tower to compare on their database what their true fate would have been without that event, and among the identified corpses was that of Sara Carr who, compared with the database, resulted in having disappeared around that date, but in fact the corpse was there, so the Thunderbolts remedied this discrepancy by making the corpse of Sara Carr and all the others who had suffered the same fate disappear.

sara ehret.name: Sara Ehret
sara ehret.origin: thumb|left|Sara's original appearance as Jackpot Dr. Sara Ehret was a pregnant scientist at Phelcorps Labs where she worked on gene therapy to cure Parkinson's disease when she was accidentally exposed to "Lot 777", a genetically modified virus. The virus rewrote the DNA in her cells, leaving her in a coma for four months. Coming out of her coma, Ehret went on to have her daughter with no complications. However, when her family came under threat by falling debris, she displayed superhuman strength in order to save them. Sara then became Jackpot, a registered super-hero. However, she wasn't interested in being a super-hero, preferring to go back to her normal life and family instead. Her friend Alana Jobson recognized Sara and showed genuine enthusiasm at paying her for the use of Sara's Jackpot identity and license. Sara took the offer in response to Alana's entreaties and gave up costumed crime fighting. Alana used a dangerous mixture of drugs including Mutant Growth Hormone, human growth hormone and anabolic steroids to grant herself superhuman powers associated with the Jackpot identity. Investigating Jackpot's identity, Spider-Man went to what he believed was Jackpot's house in Brooklyn only to find Sara Ehret, who told him she was not the super-hero and sent Spider-Man away. Spider-Man discovered the truth about Alana and Sara later nevertheless. While fighting Commanda and Blindside, Alana was pumped by Blindside with his blinding neurotoxin called Oedipus. Spider-Man came to the rescue with an antidote which cleared Alana's vision. However, Oedipus had a terrible reaction with the combination of the drugs in her body, causing Alana's fatal myocardial infarction shortly after she and Spider-Man captured the two villains. Spider-Man notified Sara about Alana's death while blaming Sara for evading her responsibilities and allowing the otherwise powerless and untrained Alana to go to her doom. Spider-Man told her that people with powers do not have a choice of giving up their responsibilities. Feeling guilty, Sara reclaimed her heroic identity and adopted a new costume. She came into conflict with Boomerang and a new Rose, who learned her identity. Under the Rose's orders, Boomerang tracked down Sara to her house and killed her husband Scott in front of her and her daughter. Sara got revenge and unmasked the Rose afterwards, but was forced to change her and her daughter's identity, taking the name Alana Jobson. sara ehret.bio: thumb|left|Sara's original appearance as Jackpot Dr. Sara Ehret was a pregnant scientist at Phelcorps Labs where she worked on gene therapy to cure Parkinson's disease when she was accidentally exposed to "Lot 777", a genetically modified virus. The virus rewrote the DNA in her cells, leaving her in a coma for four months. Coming out of her coma, Ehret went on to have her daughter with no complications. However, when her family came under threat by falling debris, she displayed superhuman strength in order to save them. Sara then became Jackpot, a registered super-hero. However, she wasn't interested in being a super-hero, preferring to go back to her normal life and family instead. Her friend Alana Jobson recognized Sara and showed genuine enthusiasm at paying her for the use of Sara's Jackpot identity and license. Sara took the offer in response to Alana's entreaties and gave up costumed crime fighting. Alana used a dangerous mixture of drugs including Mutant Growth Hormone, human growth hormone and anabolic steroids to grant herself superhuman powers associated with the Jackpot identity. Investigating Jackpot's identity, Spider-Man went to what he believed was Jackpot's house in Brooklyn only to find Sara Ehret, who told him she was not the super-hero and sent Spider-Man away. Spider-Man discovered the truth about Alana and Sara later nevertheless. While fighting Commanda and Blindside, Alana was pumped by Blindside with his blinding neurotoxin called Oedipus. Spider-Man came to the rescue with an antidote which cleared Alana's vision. However, Oedipus had a terrible reaction with the combination of the drugs in her body, causing Alana's fatal myocardial infarction shortly after she and Spider-Man captured the two villains. Spider-Man notified Sara about Alana's death while blaming Sara for evading her responsibilities and allowing the otherwise powerless and untrained Alana to go to her doom. Spider-Man told her that people with powers do not have a choice of giving up their responsibilities. Feeling guilty, Sara reclaimed her heroic identity and adopted a new costume. Sara got revenge and unmasked the Rose afterwards, but was forced to change her and her daughter's identity, taking the name Alana Jobson. sara grey.name: Sara Grey
sara grey.origin: left|thumb Sara was the older sister of Jean Grey. She was married with children. A year before Jean's supposed death in space, she and Sara were kidnapped by Attuma, who wanted to breed with surface mutants to create a superior hybrid underwater species that would help him conquer Earth. Jean defeated his forces and escaped with her sister. In the alternate future of Earth-811, she told the story to her niece Rachel Summers. Sara and her husband Paul disappeared shortly after speaking out on behalf of mutant relations. thumb It was later learned that Sara had been murdered by mutant-hating fanatics, likely acting on orders from Cameron Hodge. Her body was also absorbed by the Phalanx. They were survived by their children, Gailyn and Joey Bailey, until the Shi'ar Death Commandos slaughtered all the remaining Grey relatives with the exception of Marvel Girl and Cable.

sara harrington.name: Sara Harrington
sara harrington.origin: Sara Harrington was an intern who had just started working in the New York City newspaper The Daily Bugle, officially helping veteran journalist Ben Urich. While they were working, Bugle owner J. Jonah Jameson interrupted them so shay that the newspaper had to be shut down for one day, the papers' computers being disconnected. So as to not lose the work they had advanced, Urich had Harrington illegal hack in the Bugle files to obtain Urich's own stories. Although Urich had tried to instill patience in Harrington, he himself got impatient and pressed Harrington to get results. While doing so, Harrington found an unpublished investigation by Urich revealing that blind lawyer Matthew Murdock was really the superhero Daredevil, something that Urich had discovered but not shared. Deciding that this would be a big story for herself, Harrington worked to obtain more documents that validate the proof. In the process, she even sneaked physically at Urich's home in the night, and Urich reacted at the barely-seen intruder by hitting her in the hand with a bat - which required Harrington to bandage her hand. The following morning, when Urich saw Harrington's bandaged hand, he suspected. Harrington tried to sell her story to the Big Apple Advocate, an ill-reputed tabloid; to cover their backs, they used the headline "Matt Murdock is Daredevil?" with a question mark. Urich publicly confronted Harrington at the restaurant Greasy Spoon Diner; later, she was interviewed by TV reporter Robert Dennehy of WFET news in front of Murdock's apartment, then Urich burst to accuse her of breaking and entering, and claiming that she had no proof, with the TV cameras watching. Murdock's lawyer friend "Foggy" Nelson contacted Judge Carter to get a restraining order against Harrington so that she could not harass Murdock (whose apartment was already targetted by criminals angry at Daredevil). Harrington went to Murdock's apartment with WFET news, including Dennehy. While Nelson presented the restraint order, Harrington ignored him and entered the apartment. The TV found an apartment adapted for a blind man, with padded furniture and braille maps (which Murdock himself had modified the previous night) which made Harrington ridiculous. Harrington was next arrested by the Computer Crimes Division of FBI under charges of phone fraud (even if she had hoped for at least section 1030 computer intrusion).

sara heart.name: Sara Heart
sara heart.origin: Dr. Sara Heart was a geologist and a member of the Keewazi. When the tribe's government entered in an agreement with Roxxon to let them drill their land, Sara took readings of their perforation and determined that they were too close to a maze of subterranean passages where a collective of Moloids lived. As she was warning her fellow tribe members of this, the ground broke and the Moloids attacked the surface in retaliation. Keewazi leader Wyatt Wingfoot managed to defuse the situation. After making amends, the Keewazi welcomed the Moloids into their tribe. The Moloids coexisted on the surface for a week until the Mole Man became aware of their mingling with the Keewazi and threatened them to return underground. In response, Wyatt signalled the Fantastic Four, but the call was only heeded by the Human Torch and his partner Sky. A day after issuing the warning, the Mole Man attacked Silver Rock Springs with a group of dinosaurs. A fight broke out until Sky used her powers to explain to the Mole Man's dinosaurs that their master was in the wrong, putting an abrupt end to his intrusion.

sara jessen.name: Sara Jessen
sara jessen.origin: While accompanying a reluctant Franklin to public school, his future self told him that he would miss out on so many opportunities if he didn't go. As soon as they arrived, observing three girls talking to each other, future Franklin recognized Sara Jessen. Young Franklin said he hated her, her stupid face, and her stupid friends, and that the day before, he had almost punched her in the nose because she was teasing him. He stopped when he saw future Franklin laughing slyly and asked why he was smiling and that he was freaking out. Future Franklin, still sneering, told him he didn't want to ruin the surprise that awaited him in the future.

sara kelly.name: Sara Kelly
sara kelly.origin: Sara Kelly was the daughter of military officer John Kelly and his wife Karen, together. After John served in a war, he worked as a police officer in the NYPD, operating in the Bronx, but his methods were perceived as too brutal and led to him having several brushes with Internal Affairs. Karen began to perceive John as a dangerous man and, not wanting to raise a young girl with him as a constant influence, she left with Sara and divorced him, for which he refused to blame her too much. left|thumb|As a little girl, during her parents' divorce However, the situation was very frustrating to John, whose confidence in Karen had shattered. Thou John never tried to contact Karen or Sara again, his failed family life, combined with his willingness to accept any necessary sacrifice for the cause, especially sacrifices he himself was to made, led to him volunteering to become a cyborg warrior in an innovative process by Cybertek Systems. Cybertek turned John into the cyborg Deathlok, John's consciousness still controlling the advanced body - but in a test run, the onboard computer electrocuted John's brain dead. Cybertek replaced the brain in the cyborg, discarding John's then-useless brain. One of Cybertek's scientists, Billy Hansen, performed experiments on the brain, trying to keep it alive with nanotechnology that were instructed to replicate the brain using its available DNA. Hansen discarded the experiment, dumping the brain - but the nanotechnology, still operational, evolved by absorbing whatever was around it until it become the monster Biohazard. Wanting to be complete, Biohazard was after John Kelly's memories, which he could recover by absorbing people biologically related to him. This led to Biohazard having brushes with law enforcement agency S.H.I.E.L.D., who had files on Kelly, and then to Biohazard going after the new cyborg Deathlok, who still had biological partes of Kelly's body. Biohazard then went after John's ex-wife and daughter, wanting to absorb them into its body so as to "be together again". Deathlok and S.H.I.E.L.D. followed it to stop it and save both women. Biohazard found Karen and Sara riding horses in Central Park, Sara mockingly suggesting that her mother was too old to keep up with her, Karen reacting by racing her to the stables. The huge monster scared the women and the horses, Karen falling to the ground and immediately helped by Sara. Then Deathlok intercepted Biohazard, refusing to let it attack the women, but offering alternatives before fighting. Deathlok and S.H.I.E.L.D. stopped Biohazard, canning its brain and then S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Angstrom, in a Mandroid Armor, burned the monster's body in Central Park, with Karen and Sara witnessing it. Deathlok and S.H.I.E.L.D. confirmed that the women were well (Karen had some minor scratches and a broken leg, thou Sara had only a small bruise and a very scary experience).

sara krowler.name: Sara Krowler
sara krowler.origin: She was taught rudimentary magic by her father, Heinrich Krowler, so she could spy on people for him and report back to him. He arranged for her marriage to Nikolai Mordo. She gave birth to Karl Amadeus Mordo. Nikolai planned to recreate the Carpathian kingdom, and just when he was about to pull it off, Sarah acted as a conduit for her father's magic, and killed Nikolai. She took Karl and left to live with her father, who tutored the young boy. In his teens, Karl overheard Heinrich and Sarah discuss killing Nikolai, and he vowed revenge. Years later, after a battle with Doctor Strange, Heinrich returned to Germany in a weakened state. sara robbins.name: Sara Robbins
sara robbins.origin: Sara dated Parker Robbins for a while and eventually became pregnant with his child. They moved in together so that she could attend nightly stenography classes at ESU while Parker worked odd jobs. The odd jobs he claimed to work were actually robberies of various sorts, based on intel given to him by his cousin, John King. Unknown to Sara, Parker was not only involved in criminal activities, but involved in relationships with other women as well. He remained a steady and consistent customer of a Russian prostitute named Gro, and later was seemingly romantically involved with Madame Masque. Sara once almost caught Parker in his lies, finding a condom in his pocket during her pregnancy. He explained this away as the last thing his father gave to him before he died, and Sara chalked up her paranoia to the pregnancy hormones, asking him to always be honest with her. After the birth of their daughter, Bree, Parker moved them into a much better neighborhood using his newfound criminal wealth. Battling with his "inner demon," Dormammu, Parker began to lose control over his demonic connection, and when Dormammu appeared to him through his daughter, he was furious. As he picked up the child and shook her, Sara walked in, and made him leave them. It would seem that Parker respected her request, and after he was captured during the Siege of Asgard, Tigra informed Sara of his imprisonment. Because she had somehow learned that her daughter was possessed by the demon lord Dormammu and that Parker was only trying to exorcise him from their daughter, she visited him, and he likely revealed his true activities to her.

sara wolfe.name: Sara Wolfe
sara wolfe.origin: Sara Wolfe is of Cheyenne origin. Her great-grandfather was the shaman of her clan, who wanted to teach her the craft, but she chose a different path. She ran into Clea while Clea was being chased by Dormammu's wraiths while investigating Wong's disappearance, and offered to swap bodies so that Clea could follow Wong's trail. Sara stayed in the Sanctum alone until Dr. Strange returned from an encounter with Mordo, and brought him up to speed on what had happened to Clea. She informed Strange that his bills were unpaid and he had no money, and he offered to have her come on as his secretary so that someone could handle earthly matters and he could keep focus on the mystical. She became the secretary of Doctor Strange and the love interest of his assistant, Wong. However, their affection could not be because Wong had been promised to another since childhood. As part of his "Faust Gambit," Baron Mordo severed Sarah's soul from her body and trapped it in a sphere along with his own as part of a scheme to defeat Doctor Strange. He later recanted and released her.

saracen vampire.name: Saracen (Vampire)
saracen vampire.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Saracen became one of the first vampires on Earth, and he has successfully survived to the modern era. Therefore, he is considered a member of the group of extremely long-lived vampires known as the Ancient, along with Nosferatu, Verdelet, Boy, Maracen, and Lamia. ===Modern Age=== Saracen resided beneath the Vatican with his servant Boy. Together, they summoned their demonic servant Reaper via an ancient crypt beneath the Colosseum. After being decapitated, Maracen's head was put in garlic essence with silver, preventing his body's regeneration. The undead prophet Scribe sent the head to Saracen, who destroyed it.

sarah crawley.name: Sarah Crawley
sarah crawley.origin: Sarah Crawley was invited by her best friend, Rory Matthieson, to a simposium on renewable resources at the Empire State University. When the demonstration for Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.' Catalyst was interrupted by the Lethal Legion, Rory died shielding Sarah from Whirlwind. After the villains were seemingly killed by the Sin-Eater, Sarah was one of the spectators who applauded him. After the incident, Sarah was interviewed by reporter Norah Winters for Threats and Menaces, and she brought up Rory as the reason why she applauded the murderous vigilante.

sarah gail bradley.name: Sarah Gail Bradley
sarah gail bradley.origin: ===Origin=== After losing the secrets of the Super Soldier Serum when Dr. Erskine was assassinated, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super Soldiers like Steve Rogers. To this end, Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel took 300 African-American soldiers from Mississippi to experiment upon. Only a handful of men survived the gruesome process, and only one of them survived the covert missions and assignments: Isaiah Bradley. However, before Isaiah received the Super Soldier Serum, he fathered Sarah Gail, named after her grandmothers. ===Josiah X=== In 1953, years before Isaiah was released, Faith briefly moved with her young daughter from The Bronx to Mount Vernon, Virginia. It was here that a young girl appeared claiming to have her son. The girl explained how the U.S. military had harvested semen from Isaiah (before the Super Soldier Serum made him sterile) and eggs from Faith during her appendectomy surgery, and about the thirty-eight failed attempts that occurred before Josiah was finally carried to term. Faith kept the child, but for the safety of herself, her daughter and her son, she had to abandon him on a train. Sarah Gail left the note identifying the infant simply as "Josiah". left|thumb|340px|Sarah Gail meets the grown Josiah X Twenty-five years later, still in Mount Vernon, Josiah returned to the Bradley home and met his mother, sister, and childlike father. Unable to stay long for fear of being discovered, Faith told Josiah to return when it was time. Although the Bradley family moved back to their home in the Bronx, Josiah came to visit periodically to spend time with the family he never had. Josiah eventually stopped visiting and had not been seen by the family in over a year as of ===Patriot=== Sarah Gail mothered at least five children, including Eli Bradley, and married at least twice. Sarah Gail was born before her father took the Super Soldier Serum, so neither she nor her children (including Eli) were born with any superhuman abilities. Sarah Gail eventually remarried, and moved to Scottsdale, Arizona with all of her children except her son Eli. Eli stayed in the Bronx, living with his grandparents to complete high school. Eli eventually moved to Arizona to live with his mother after leaving the Young Avengers.

sarah garrett.name: Sarah Garrett
sarah garrett.origin: After John Garrett had sneaked into the Department of the Treasury pretending to be an official from the Department of Energy to meet Seth Waters and find out where his loyalties lay, Waters was not fooled and already knew who Garrett really was, to the point of naming all the members of his family, including his mother Sarah.

sarah garza.name: Sarah Garza
sarah garza.species: Human with Inhuman lineage activated by a Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
sarah garza.origin: Sarah Garza was a S.H.I.E.L.D. computer specialist. During Thanos' Invasion, Inhuman king Black Bolt released the Terrigen Mists upon the entire face of Earth, activating the latent powers of numerous Inhuman descendants. Sarah was one of the newly surfaced Inhumans, but shortly after emerging from a cocoon, her unstable powers created an explosion which decimated her entire apartment complex in the process. thumb|left|Prior the Terrigenesis She was retained by S.H.I.E.L.D., and Maria Hill, after finding out she was one of theirs, realized Garza could be a potential asset against Thanos' forces. Although she lacked experience, Hill partnered her with Iron Patriot, and gave her an armor to control her powers. She and Iron Patriot arrived to Brooklyn as reinforcements to help Nick Fury Jr. and Phil Coulson fight the invading forces. Sarah created a powerful blast which, along with the support of the Iron Patriot Drones, annihilated the aliens. During the sweep, the heroes were attacked by an unknown enemy with telekinetic powers. When Nick Fury tried to talk to him, the Junkman threw a car at the team, seemingly crushing Garza. Sarah raised from the debris, with the totality of her powers unleashed, and retaliated the Junkman. When he was about to be killed, Garza stopped upon realizing she could not become a murderer. Before he could react, Fury sniped at the Junkman and killed him. Saddened, Sarah mourned him. Back in the Helicarrier, Sarah expressed to Maria Hill the desire to go back to tech ops. Garza was confined in a cell until her powers could be stabilized.
